capitec-bank-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
Capitec Bank's Savannah Mall branch serves personal and small-business clients from the ground floor of the centre in Fauna Park. Capitec is South Africa's largest digital bank by active clients, and the branch helps customers get set up on its Global One account, which combines everyday transactions and high-interest savings and is managed through the Capitec banking app with zero-rated data. Consultants also assist with term loans, credit cards, access facilities and Capitec Business packages aimed at small and medium-sized local enterprises.

The branch has service cubicles for one-on-one help, ATMs on site and wheelchair-accessible parking and entry, with a separate 24-hour Capitec ATM elsewhere in the mall at Shop 50A. It trades from Shop G35 and is open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 8am to 5pm, Wednesday from 8:30am to 5pm and Saturday from 8am to 1pm, and is closed on Sundays.

dr-t-g-mulaudzi-seshego-zone-1.description:
This general practice on Nelson Mandela Drive provides everyday primary healthcare to families and individuals in Seshego. Patients can come in for general check-ups and examinations, have a chronic condition managed and their medication scripted, or book a family planning consultation. The practice also carries out minor procedures and assesses patients who need a medical certificate for work or school.

Patients can book an appointment or simply walk in and wait to be seen, and the practice accepts both cash payments and claims through major South African medical aids. Unusually for a local GP, it is open seven days a week: Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:45pm, and on Saturdays and Sundays from 8am to 11:45am. That makes it a practical choice for Seshego Zone 1 residents who need a doctor close to home, including over the weekend.

african-bank-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
African Bank's Mall of the North branch offers everyday banking, credit and cover for shoppers in and around Bendor. Clients can open a MyWORLD account, which carries no monthly fee and lets them add up to five free pockets for shared family spending or higher-interest savings. The branch also handles personal loans and debt consolidation loans of up to R500,000, along with credit cards, overdrafts and tech bundles that add a device to a credit line.

Beyond day-to-day accounts, the team assists with investments, funeral cover and the Isiko lifestyle offering, which helps families budget for cultural ceremonies and milestones. Customers have free Wi-Fi while they wait, and an on-site ATM handles quick cash withdrawals. The branch trades from Shop L43a at Mall of the North and is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, closed on Sundays and public holidays.

aldo-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
ALDO at Mall of the North stocks fashion footwear, bags and accessories for men and women. The women's range runs from statement heels, strappy dress sandals and metallic pumps to leather boots, everyday flats and matching shoe-and-handbag sets. Men will find formal dress shoes, workwear, casual slip-ons and smart sneakers, along with backpacks and carry bags. Sunglasses, jewellery and cushioned insoles from ALDO's comfort lines, such as Pillow Walk, round out the selection.

Shoppers often mention the friendly staff, who are happy to help style a look for a special event. The store offers click-and-collect pickup, in-store returns, gift cards and sign-up to the ALDO A-List loyalty programme. It is on the upper level at Shop U45 and is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

archive-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Archive at Mall of the North is a sneaker and streetwear store for shoppers who follow the latest releases. Its walls carry sneakers from Nike, including Air Force 1 '07 styles, as well as Adidas, Puma, New Balance and Asics, with new drops and limited-edition pairs arriving through the season. Alongside the footwear, the store sells casual streetwear such as branded graphic T-shirts, hoodies and outerwear, plus caps, sports socks and seasonal accessories to complete a look.

Reviews regularly single out the store's customer service and its friendly, upbeat team, as well as the range of streetwear on offer. Archive trades from Shop U75 on the upper level of the mall in Bendor and is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm, making it an easy stop for anyone hunting for a fresh pair of sneakers.

browns-jewellers-mall-of-the-north-bendo.description:
Browns Jewellers is a South African, family-owned diamond jeweller that has been trading since 1934, and its Mall of the North store brings that heritage to Bendor. The store focuses on its own designs rather than third-party watch or accessory brands, using natural, conflict-free diamonds sourced mainly from Southern Africa. Customers come in for diamond engagement rings, wedding bands for women and men in gold or platinum, and pieces set with tanzanite, morganite, emeralds and rubies.

Jewellery advisors guide clients through a choice in an unhurried consultation, and the workshop team can take on custom designs. Through the Browns care plan, existing jewellery can be cleaned, polished and rhodium plated, resized, re-tipped or have loose stones tightened, and pieces can be valued. A three-month lay-by is available. The store is at Shop U47 on the upper level and is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

capitec-bank-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
The Capitec Bank branch on the lower level of Mall of the North gives Bendor shoppers in-person help with the bank's paperless Global One system. Consultants can set up an account with linked debit or credit cards and up to four savings plans, all of which clients then run from the Capitec smartphone app. The branch also helps with debt consolidation, reversing unwanted debit orders, personal credit of up to R250,000 and funeral cover, and supports small and medium businesses with Capitec Business transaction banking.

Alongside its consultant counters, the branch offers self-service terminals and ATMs that accept deposits, and it is fully wheelchair accessible from parking to entrance. Two further 24-hour Capitec ATMs operate inside the mall, at Shop U98 on the upper level and Shop L10A. The branch is at Shop L42 and is open weekdays from 9am to 6pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, closed on Sundays and public holidays.

medicare-pharmacy-polokwane-central.description:
Medicare Pharmacy is a community retail pharmacy on Rissik Street in the Polokwane city centre. Its main focus is dispensing, from once-off prescriptions to the monthly chronic medication that many regular patients rely on. The pharmacy team also gives general healthcare advice and helps customers choose from its range of over-the-counter medicines and wellness products, which is useful for anyone who wants guidance without seeing a doctor first.

For patients who find it hard to come in each month, the pharmacy offers home delivery of their regular medical essentials. The entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible, and cash, debit and credit cards, and tap-to-pay from a phone are all accepted. Medicare Pharmacy is at 12d Rissik Street and is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm.

ackermans-checkers-centre-polokwane-cent.description:
The Ackermans branch in Checkers Centre on Grobler Street brings the value retailer's family clothing and cellular range to the Polokwane CBD. Parents shopping on a budget can kit out babies, toddlers and older children here, including character-print T-shirts and other kids' favourites. For adults, the store carries casual women's clothing, footwear, sleepwear and everyday basics at affordable prices.

A cellular counter sells prepaid smartphones, phone accessories, chargers, SIM starter packs and airtime, which is handy for anyone in town who needs to get connected quickly. The store has a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking, and offers free Wi-Fi for customers. It opens at 8:30am on Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays and at 8am on Tuesdays, closing at 5:30pm on weekdays, and trades from 8am to 3pm on Saturdays and from 9am to 2pm on Sundays.

american-swiss-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
American Swiss at Savannah Mall is a branch of the South African jewellery chain that traces its history back to 1896. The Fauna Park store is a destination for couples shopping for diamond engagement rings, bridal sets and anniversary bands, available in gold, silver and platinum settings. For everyday wear and gifting, it stocks gold necklaces, statement earrings, lockets, bracelets and initial pendants, along with men's and women's watches from international brands.

Local reviewers rate the store highly, and its entrance and parking are fully wheelchair accessible. American Swiss is at Shop 24 in Savannah Mall, on the corner of Grobler and Grimm streets, and is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm and Saturdays from 9am to 5pm, with shorter hours on Sundays and public holidays.

cappuccinos-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Cappuccinos at Mall of the North is a full-service Italian restaurant, pizzeria and grill that runs from breakfast through to late dinner. Mornings start with cooked breakfasts, speciality coffees, cappuccinos and milkshakes. Later in the day the menu turns to wood-fired pizzas, pasta dishes such as fettuccine, stromboli and burgers, along with flame-grilled short ribs, sirloin steaks, chicken winglets and lamb chops. The restaurant is known for its regular value specials, such as Italian Mondays with discounted pizzas and pastas.

The restaurant is licensed and serves cocktails alongside its meals, and it is well suited to families, with highchairs for toddlers and tables that can seat larger groups. Takeaway orders can be collected from the restaurant on the mall's upper level at Shop U104. It is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 10pm, Friday and Saturday until 11pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 8am to 9pm.

city-centre-pharmacy-polokwane-central.description:
City Centre Pharmacy is an independent community pharmacy in the heart of the Polokwane CBD, also known by its registered name, Limpopo Phelang Pharmacy. It serves commuters, travellers passing through town and residents of the city centre, with a focus on prescription dispensing and the ongoing management of chronic medication. Patients who want to keep costs down can ask about generic alternatives to branded medicines.

The front shop stocks over-the-counter remedies, basic healthcare aids, vitamins and supplements for the whole family, everyday skincare and baby care products. Service at the counter is quick, and cash, debit and credit cards, and tap-to-pay are accepted. The pharmacy is at Shop 17 in the City Centre Complex on Bok Street, near the corner of Rissik Street, with a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking close to the complex entrance.

clicks-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
Clicks Savannah is a pharmacy and health and beauty store at Savannah Mall in Fauna Park. Its dispensary fills prescriptions, offers generic alternatives and gives pharmacist advice, and regular patients can have repeat medication pre-packed for collection. The on-site clinic offers family planning, blood pressure and other health checks, baby clinic visits and vaccinations.

Beyond the pharmacy, the store is laid out in beauty aisles with cosmetics, skincare and fragrance, a baby section with nappies, food and care products, vitamins and supplements, and small home and electrical appliances. Shoppers can collect online orders in store or choose home delivery, and ClubCard members earn cashback points and get instant deals on selected items. The store is at Shop 3, on the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki streets, and is open from 8am to 6pm on weekdays (9am on Wednesdays), 8am to 5pm on Saturdays, 9am to 2pm on Sundays and 9am to 3pm on public holidays.

kuaho-attorneys-polokwane-central.description:
Kuaho Attorneys is a black-owned general law practice that has served clients from Polokwane's city centre since 2002. A large part of its work is third-party claims, particularly Road Accident Fund claims, where the firm represents people injured in road accidents through to settlement. It also handles divorce and family law matters, debt collection for businesses, contract drafting and civil litigation.

The firm's practitioners have rights of appearance in administrative forums, the regional and magistrates' courts and the High Court, so clients can be represented at every level of a matter. The practice is registered with the provincial legal council and has grown to include a satellite office in Pretoria. Consultations are by appointment at its office at 29 Voortrekker Street in Polokwane Central, which is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:45pm and closed on weekends and public holidays.

total-sports-paledi-mall-mankweng.description:
Totalsports at Paledi Mall is a sports and athleisure store, part of The Foschini Group, serving athletes, gym-goers and students in Mankweng and around the University of Limpopo. Its footwear wall covers running and training shoes, soccer and rugby boots, court shoes and lifestyle sneakers from brands including Nike, Adidas, Puma, New Balance, Asics and Under Armour.

The clothing range is built for training and match days, with moisture-wicking T-shirts, running shorts, tights, sports bras, tracksuits and windbreakers, as well as replica kits of South African teams. Kit bags, sports socks, water bottles, caps, soccer balls and shin guards round out the gear on offer. Shoppers describe the store as neat and easy to find their way around, with an upbeat feel on the floor. Totalsports is at Shop 38 in Paledi Mall on the R71 and generally follows the mall's trading hours: weekdays from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 3pm.

xclusive-spot-seshego-zone-1.description:
Xclusive Spot is a lifestyle venue in Seshego that combines a casual restaurant and takeaway, a chill spot, a car wash and a space for live performance. The kitchen serves relaxed comfort food: burgers, including its Funky Thursday deals, pizzas with cold drinks, traditional Sunday lunches, and braai plates and platters. Meals can be enjoyed with table service at the venue or ordered for collection.

The venue has become a popular place for locals to unwind over the weekend, especially at its Sunday chill sessions. Its social calendar includes live music, DJ line-ups featuring sounds such as lekompo, dance challenges, stand-up comedy and performing arts workshops for young people, so there is often something on. With the car wash on site, visitors can have their vehicle cleaned while they eat or relax. Xclusive Spot is at 173 Chris Hani Drive, on the corner of Bookelo Street, in Seshego Zone 1, and stays open late on Fridays and weekends.

ackermans-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Ackermans at Mall of the North is a value family store selling affordable clothing, schoolwear, homeware and cellular products. Its baby and kids' department covers infants from three months through to young teens, alongside baby toiletries. Ahead of each school year, parents can pick up uniforms, school shoes, backpacks and stationery in one visit, while the women's range takes in casual dresses, tops, denim and leggings. The store also stocks bathroom linen, bedroom accessories and kitchen drinkware.

A cellular counter sells budget smartphones, tablets, Wi-Fi routers, data, airtime and chargers. Shoppers regularly mention how clean and neatly arranged the store is and how quickly staff help at the tills. Online orders can be collected in store, and customers can pay in cash, by card or tap, buy on interest-free lay-by or use a store account. The store is at Shop L53 on the lower level and is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

american-swiss-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
The American Swiss store on the upper level of Mall of the North sells diamond, gold and silver jewellery and branded watches to shoppers in Bendor and beyond. Its bridal counter covers diamond engagement rings, wedding bands, multi-stone bridal sets and promise rings, with settings in yellow, white or rose gold and platinum. Beyond bridal, the cabinets hold gold and sterling silver necklaces, tennis bracelets, earrings and pendants for gifts and special occasions.

A large watch counter carries men's and women's styles from brands including Fossil, Michael Kors, Citizen, Casio and Guess. Reviewers often mention the store's modern layout, its secure and private feel, and how efficiently staff handle each sale. The store is fully wheelchair accessible and trades from Shop U41, opening weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

bathu-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Bathu is a proudly South African sneaker brand, started in 2015, and its Mall of the North store carries the brand's own lifestyle sneakers for men, women and children. The range is built around colourful, comfortable everyday designs, including the original Mesh Edition with its breathable upper and the Journey Edition, a nod to the brand's motto, "Walk Your Journey". Alongside the sneakers, the store sells matching streetwear such as tracksuits, T-shirts and branded socks, as well as shoe-care kits to keep a pair looking new.

Online orders can be collected in store, returns and exchanges are handled on site, and cash, card and contactless payments are accepted. The store is on the upper level at Shop U18 and is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

biltong-pret-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Biltong Pret at Mall of the North is a specialist biltong and dried-meat shop serving traditional South African flavours. Its counter is stocked with spiced beef biltong that can be bought in chunks or sliced to order, with customers choosing how wet or dry, and how fatty or lean, they like it. Game lovers can pick up wildsbiltong, game droëwors and chilli bites, while classic droëwors and ready-made snack packs suit anyone wanting something to eat on the go.

The shop also puts together gifts for birthdays, holidays and events, including biltong bouquets and meat hampers, a handy option for anyone hard to shop for. Meat is sliced fresh over the counter, and cash, debit and credit cards are accepted. Biltong Pret is on the lower level of the mall at Shop L74 and is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

brazilia-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Brazilia at Mall of the North is a footwear and fashion store known for imported shoes, many of them made from Brazilian leather. For women, it stocks leather heels, statement pumps, platform wedges, formal sandals, casual boots and jelly shoes, from brands such as Schutz, Pegada and Opananken. Men can choose from leather dress shoes, slip-ons and casual sneakers by labels including Florsheim and Merrell, along with jeans and chinos. Handbags, wallets and seasonal accessories complete the range.

Shoppers often mention how helpful the sales assistants are in finding something that suits both their style and their budget. Orders placed on the Brazilia webstore can be collected in store, and exchanges and returns are handled at the counter. The store has wheelchair-accessible entry and parking, and is at Shop L18a on the lower level. It is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

burger-king-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Burger King at Mall of the North serves the chain's flame-grilled burgers on the upper level of the mall, and the branch is fully halaal certified. Mornings start with a breakfast menu of burgers and muffins, including local takes with boerewors and chakalaka, served until 11am. After that the full menu takes over, led by the Whopper, the Big King and stacked beef burgers, alongside a boerewors burger, crispy chicken burgers, nuggets and tenders, and vegan and vegetarian options.

Sides include fries, onion rings and chilli cheese bites, with milkshakes to finish. Families are well looked after, with a kids' menu, highchairs and baby-changing facilities. Orders can be eaten in, taken away or delivered through Uber Eats and Mr D. The restaurant is at Shop U69a and is open from 7am to 8pm from Sunday to Thursday, and until 9pm on Fridays and Saturdays.

gae-afrika-guest-house-lebowakgomo.description:
Gae-Afrika Guest House is a locally run guesthouse on the R579 Jane Furse Road in Lebowakgomo, directly opposite Mall@Lebo. It offers overnight rooms for business travellers, government officials visiting the area, people in town to see family, and tourists passing through the region.

Its location is the main draw: guests can walk across the road to the mall's restaurants and shops without needing to drive. Many reviewers also mention the guesthouse's lively, welcoming atmosphere. Reception is staffed around the clock, so guests can check in late, and there is secure on-site parking for vehicles overnight. The guesthouse is at Unit F, 1810 Jane Furse Road, with its entrance facing the street.

rage-game-centre-polokwane-central.description:
Rage at Game Centre is an affordable fast-fashion store in the Polokwane CBD, selling on-trend shoes, clothing and accessories. Footwear is its biggest section, especially for women, with high heels, summer wedges, strappy sandals, pumps, loafers, lace-ups, casual sneakers, and ankle and knee-high boots in season. Men and children are catered for with smart casual shoes, sneakers, loafers and flats.

The clothing side of the store focuses on youthful streetwear and everyday fashion, from dresses, jumpsuits and skirts to graphic T-shirts, jogger shorts, hoodies and light jackets. Handbags, clutches, wallets and jewellery sets help finish an outfit. Customers can pay with cash, card or tap, or open a Rage store account to spread purchases over monthly instalments. The store is at Shop 0006 in Game Centre, on the corner of Hospital and Kerk streets, with wheelchair-accessible entry and parking in the centre. It is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 5pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm.

rochester-game-centre-polokwane-central.description:
Rochester at Game Centre is a furniture store focused on elegant, timeless pieces for the lounge, dining room and bedroom. The brand has been trading since 1994 under the tagline "It's all about the look", and its range leans towards genuine leather, quality fabrics and solid wood. In the lounge section, shoppers will find motion and static lounge suites in leather or fabric, corner couches, recliners, daybeds, coffee tables and TV units.

For dining rooms, the store stocks statement tables with matching upholstered chairs, servers and sideboards. Bedroom furniture includes bed sets, mattresses, headboards, chests of drawers, pedestals and wardrobes, so a whole room can be furnished in one style. Rochester is at Shop 0021 in Game Centre, on the corner of Hospital and Kerk streets in the Polokwane CBD, and is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, closed on Sundays and public holidays.

vivo-vleismark-thornhill-estate.description:
Vivo Vleismark in Thornhill Shopping Centre is a family butchery serving neighbourhood shoppers and anyone planning a braai. Its counter offers aged rump, sirloin, T-bone and ribeye steaks cut to the thickness customers ask for, along with lamb chops, legs of lamb, pork ribs and fresh chicken. Boerewors comes in a wide variety of flavours, and droëwors and spiced beef biltong are sliced fresh at the counter.

To round off a meal, the shop stocks braai salts, marinades and sauces, charcoal and briquettes, as well as farm-style dairy and deli items. Meat can be vacuum packed for the freezer or for travelling. Reviewers regularly mention how clean the shop is, how well the meat is presented, the friendly service and the quality of the cuts. Vivo Vleismark is at Shop 13 and is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm and Saturdays from 8am to 3pm, closed on Sundays and public holidays.

babies-r-us-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Babies R Us at Mall of the North stocks everything from nursery furniture to nappies for parents-to-be and families with babies and toddlers. The store trades side by side with its sister brand, Toys R Us, so families can shop for both in one visit. Its travel section is well stocked with strollers, pram and travel systems, infant capsules and toddler car seats, while the nursery range includes wooden cots, mattresses, camp cots, baby monitors and linen.

Feeding needs are covered with breast pumps, high chairs, bottles, sterilisers, formula and toddler food, and the store keeps bulk stock of nappies, wipes, baby lotions and changing mats. Parents can set up a baby registry, earn points through the loyalty programme, collect online orders in store or have them delivered. Customers often mention how helpful staff are when explaining bigger items such as prams and car seats. The store is on the upper level at Shop U68, closest to the Spur food court and Checkers entrances, and is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

bosveld-scrap-metal-ladanna.description:
Bosveld Scrap Metal is a licensed, independent scrap metal merchant and recycling yard in the Ladanna industrial area, buying from contractors, businesses and members of the public. On the ferrous side, it takes heavy iron, structural steel, cast iron, machine turnings, sheet metal and old vehicle bodies. It also buys non-ferrous metals, including copper wire, tubing and plate, brass, aluminium cans, castings and extrusions, lead, zinc and stainless steel, as well as used lead-acid car batteries.

The yard has calibrated platform scales and a drive-on weighbridge for commercial vehicles, and metal is graded and paid out on the spot. In line with the Second-Hand Goods Act, sellers need to bring a valid ID or passport. For larger jobs, the team handles bulk site clearances, collections from factory dismantling and skip placement for building and demolition projects. The yard is at 23 Staal Street and is open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Saturdays from 7:30am to 11:30am, closed on Sundays and public holidays.

dis-chem-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
Dis-Chem at Savannah Mall is a large pharmacy and health and beauty store on the ground floor of the centre in Fauna Park. Its dispensary fills prescriptions, offers generic substitutes and gives pharmacist advice, and patients can send scripts ahead by email, SMS or WhatsApp so their medication is ready when they arrive. The in-store clinic covers family planning, baby clinic visits, wound care, basic health tests and vaccinations, and is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm.

Beyond medicine, the front shop has aisles of beauty and cosmetics, health foods, sports supplements and personal care, plus a beauty salon open from Tuesday to Saturday. Shoppers often comment on how well stocked the store is. Loyalty members earn cashback and get instant discounts at the till, and orders can be delivered or collected in store. The pharmacy is at Shop 66, with wheelchair-accessible entry and parking nearby, and is open weekdays from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 2pm.

fnb-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
FNB Mall@Lebo is a full-service First National Bank branch serving personal clients and local business owners in Lebowakgomo. Consultants help customers open and manage everyday accounts, from the FNBy account for young people and the entry-level Easy Account to the Aspire bundle, all of which can be run from the FNB app. The branch also handles credit, including overdrafts, personal loans and revolving credit, and can advise clients on managing their debt.

Lost or damaged cards can be printed and replaced on the spot, and the branch assists with savings pockets, foreign exchange and FNB Business banking for small and medium enterprises. ATMs are on site, and the branch has wheelchair-accessible entry with parking at the mall. FNB is at Shop 51A in Mall@Lebo on Jane Furse Road and is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 3:30pm and Saturdays from 8:30am to 11am, closed on Sundays and public holidays.

kfc-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
KFC Lebowakgomo serves the chain's fried chicken from Mall@Lebo, at the corner of the R518 and R579, with dine-in seating, counter service and a drive-through lane. The menu centres on Original Recipe chicken buckets, Zinger wings, Boxmaster wraps and Streetwise meals, with chips, loaded fries, gravy, coleslaw, milkshakes and soft-serve to go with them. Early risers can stop in for breakfast muffins and burgers from 7am.

The restaurant is set up for families, with plenty of seating, high chairs for toddlers and a kids' menu, as well as free Wi-Fi and wheelchair-accessible parking, entrance and restrooms. Reviewers often praise the hot, freshly prepared food, the clean dining area and the friendly, quick service, though queues can build at peak times over weekends and holidays. KFC Lebowakgomo is open Sunday to Thursday from 7am to 9pm, and Fridays and Saturdays from 7am to 10pm.

mt-horeb-presbyterian-church-polokwane-c.description:
Mt Horeb Presbyterian Church is a long-established congregation of the Uniting Presbyterian Church in Southern Africa, meeting on Kirsten Street in central Polokwane. It has served Christians in the city, formerly Pietersburg, for decades. Alongside traditional Sunday worship, church life includes regular Bible study and small group gatherings, a children's ministry that teaches young members about the faith, and the Presbyterian Women fellowship.

The church is also a meeting place for the wider community. It has hosted interdenominational gatherings such as South African Council of Churches workshops in Limpopo, as well as community workshops on caring for the environment. Its fundraising fetes are popular with neighbours, with farm-style breakfasts, clothing stalls, food stalls and jumping castles for children. Visitors and newcomers looking for a Presbyterian church home in Polokwane will find the congregation at 74 Kirsten Street.

nirvana-meat-market-nirvana.description:
Nirvana Meat Market is a halaal-certified butchery on Tagore Street that sells beef, mutton and chicken to households and wholesale buyers. Alongside everyday cuts, it stocks lamb shanks, whole legs of lamb and ready-marinated meats, as well as seafood such as prawns, crayfish and lobster. The shelves also carry free-range eggs, spices and sauces from local favourites such as Jimmy's, Sujee's and Farouky's, along with a few other grocery lines.

During Ramadan, the shop is a go-to stop in Nirvana for iftar supplies, with dates, frozen savouries and samosas, homemade pies, pizzas and sushi packs. For family gatherings and functions, the butchery prepares bulk meat platters, caters braai days and runs spit braais, so hosts can leave the cooking to the team. It is a convenient choice for anyone in Nirvana and the surrounding suburbs looking for halaal meat close to home.

side-step-bendor.description:
Side Step at Mall of the North is a sneaker and athleisure store selling casual footwear and streetwear for men and women. Its shelves carry a wide mix of international brands, including Adidas, Nike, Puma, Converse, New Balance, Vans, Asics, Ellesse and Superga, in high-tops, low-tops and everyday lifestyle styles, along with slides and flip-flops from labels such as Havaianas. Limited-edition releases also land in store from time to time.

To go with the footwear, the store stocks sport and lifestyle clothing from brands like Levi's and The North Face, including graphic T-shirts, track pants, hoodies and jackets, plus caps, socks and sports bags. Side Step describes itself as LGBTQ+ friendly, and the store has wheelchair-accessible entry. Online orders can be collected in store, and shoppers can pay by cash, card or tap, or use lay-by. It is on the upper level at Shop U78a and is open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

sleepmasters-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
Sleepmasters at Savannah Mall is a specialist bed and mattress store that helps shoppers find the right level of comfort for their budget. It stocks mattresses and bed sets in single, three-quarter, double, queen and king sizes from well-known makers such as Sealy, Restonic, Simmons, Serta and Cloud Nine, alongside the chain's own value range. To complete the bedroom, it also sells headboards, bases, orthopaedic pillows and memory foam mattress protectors.

Customers often praise the store's knowledgeable sleep consultants, who guide buyers to a bed based on their comfort preferences. Shoppers can pay in cash, by card or tap, use in-store credit or lay-by, and arrange home delivery. The store is on the ground floor at Shop G20, with wheelchair-accessible entry and parking, and is open weekdays from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 3pm.

total-janpret-trekkers-ladanna.description:
Total Janpret Trekkers is a TotalEnergies fuel station on Witklip Street, off Dendron Road in the Ladanna and Annadale industrial area, that serves both everyday motorists and the farming community. Alongside the forecourt, the site has a tractor workshop and spares office, so farmers and contractors can refuel and arrange parts or repairs for their machinery in one stop. The pumps supply unleaded petrol and TotalEnergies Excellium Diesel, which is designed to keep engines clean in cars, trucks and tractors alike.

Attendants offer full service at the pumps, including tyre pressure checks, window washing and oil checks on request. Customers can pay with cash, debit or credit cards, and fleet payment options are available for commercial vehicles. The forecourt is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, while the workshop and spares office trade Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 5pm and Fridays from 7:30am to 4pm.

dis-chem-bophelomed-pharmacy-lebowakgomo.description:
Dis-Chem Bophelomed Pharmacy is a community pharmacy in Phasha Shopping Centre on Jane Furse Road, Lebowakgomo, near the turn-off to Zebediela. Its script counter dispenses chronic and acute medication, suggests generic alternatives and advises on over-the-counter treatments, and it is a registered GEMS network pharmacy for government employees on that medical scheme. Patients can pre-order scripts through Dis-Chem's app so they spend less time waiting.

An on-site clinic offers basic health checks, baby clinic visits, family planning advice, wound care and vaccinations. The front shop carries beauty and cosmetics, health foods, sports supplements and personal care products, and online orders can be collected in store. Dis-Chem Benefit members earn cashback points at the till. The pharmacy is at Shop 15G and is open weekdays from 8am to 5pm, Saturdays from 8am to 2pm and Sundays from 9am to 1pm.

peace-loving-spa-hospark.description:
Peace Loving Spa is an independent massage and wellness studio in a converted house on Voortrekker Street in Hospital Park, focused on stress relief, body recovery and easing tension. Its treatment menu includes Swedish full-body massage, deep tissue work, hot stone therapy, foot massages and aromatherapy oil sessions. Therapists can tailor pressure-point treatments for sports recovery or for relaxation during pregnancy, and the spa offers couples' massages and pamper packages for special occasions or gifts.

Clients describe a calm, quiet setting with private treatment rooms, clean facilities and soft music in the background. Bookings can be made in advance by phone call or text message, and payment is by cash or bank transfer. The spa is open every day from 8am to 9pm, which makes it easy to fit in a session after work or over the weekend.

rite-price-liquor-store-ladanna.description:
Rite Price Liquor Store is a bottle store on Witklip Street in the Ladanna industrial area that sells at wholesale-style prices to everyone, not just trade buyers. That makes it a popular stop for people stocking up for parties and events or buying in bulk. The store carries a wide range of local and imported beers, ciders and stouts, boxed and bottled wines, sparkling wine and champagne, and spirits including brandy, whisky, gin and vodka, along with ready-to-drink coolers.

Bags of ice and mixers are also on hand, so customers can pick up everything for a gathering in one stop. Payment is by cash, card or tap, and most customers buy in store and take their order with them. Weekdays are usually quiet, with the busiest times on Friday afternoons and weekends. The store is open Monday to Thursday from 9am to 7pm, Fridays and Saturdays from 9am to 8pm, and Sundays from 9am to 5pm.

w-h-saffer-superbia.description:
W H Saffer is a plumbing and sanitary ware merchant in the Superbia industrial area, supplying building contractors, plumbers and members of the public. Its showroom displays toilets, basins, bathtubs, kitchen sinks, shower enclosures and bathroom tap ranges for anyone building or renovating a bathroom or kitchen. On the plumbing side, the merchant stocks electric and solar geysers, water storage tanks, drainage pipes, copper tubing, PVC fittings and valves, as well as drain jetting equipment and leak detection accessories.

The warehouse is laid out for trade, with a public counter and drive-in collection for contractors picking up larger orders. Regular customers can buy on a trade account, while walk-in buyers can pay in cash or by debit or credit card. W H Saffer is at 40 Nikkel Street in Superbia, making it a practical supplier for residential and commercial plumbing projects across Polokwane.

pick-n-pay-clothing-mall-of-the-north-be.description:
Pick n Pay Clothing at Mall of the North is a standalone fashion store from the Pick n Pay group, selling affordable everyday clothing and basics for the whole family. The women's section includes seasonal dresses, linen co-ords, T-shirts, activewear, denim, sleepwear and underwear. Men will find smart-casual shirts, chinos, shorts, jeans, jackets, tees and socks, while the kids' range runs from newborn and toddler clothing to older children's fashion and value multi-packs.

Sandals, flats, canvas sneakers, sun hats, belts and tote bags complete the range. Shoppers often comment on the neat displays, the low prices and how quickly the till queues move. Smart Shopper members earn and spend points at checkout, online orders can be collected in store, and cash, card and tap payments are accepted. The store is wheelchair accessible and trades from Shop L23 on the lower level, open weekdays from 9am to 7pm, and weekends and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

miladys-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
Miladys at Mall@Lebo is a women's fashion store from the Mr Price Group, focused on comfortable, stylish clothing cut to fit real women's bodies. The range takes in smart-casual separates, denim, dresses for every season, light knitwear, blouses, activewear and sleepwear, with regular, petite and fuller-figure sizes available. Wedges, flats, sandals and slip-on walking shoes sit alongside handbags, sun hats, scarves, sunglasses and fashion jewellery.

Shoppers describe a relaxed, unhurried store with tidy fitting rooms and attentive assistants who are on hand to help. Customers can pay with cash, card or tap, or use a Mr Price Group store account to spread the cost monthly, and online orders can be collected in store. Miladys is at Shop 6 in Mall@Lebo, with wheelchair-accessible entry and parking, and generally keeps the mall's hours: weekdays from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 3pm.

ivy-med-24-ivy-park.description:
Ivy Med 24 is a general practice in the Health Village Centre on Marshall Street, at the corner of Church Street, offering everyday GP care for adults and families. Patients come in for general consultations, ongoing monitoring of chronic conditions and repeat medication scripts, and the doctors can issue medical certificates when needed.

The practice works on a flexible system, seeing walk-in patients as well as those who book a consultation in advance. It accepts major South African medical aids, and patients without cover can pay in cash or by card. The centre has wheelchair-accessible entrances, restrooms and parking. Despite the "24" in its name, the practice is not open around the clock: it sees patients Monday to Friday from 8am to 8pm, and on Saturdays and Sundays from 8am to 2pm, which makes it a useful option for evening and weekend visits.

a1-construction-sterpark.description:
A1 Construction is a building contractor based on Grobler Street in Sterpark that takes on both residential and commercial work across Polokwane. Its projects run from the foundations and concrete work through to the final finishes, so clients can use one contractor for the whole job. The company handles new builds, structural renovations and smaller upgrades to existing homes and business premises.

On every project, the team focuses on sound structural work, safety on site and keeping to agreed deadlines, using quality materials chosen to last. That makes it a fit for homeowners planning an extension or new house, as well as businesses looking to build or refurbish their premises. A1 Construction operates from 150 Grobler Street, Sterpark.

dr-nc-ngobeni-fauna-park.description:
This general dental practice on Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park looks after the oral health of patients of all ages, from young children to adults and older patients. Its focus is on keeping teeth and gums healthy over the long term, combining clinical skill with a caring approach so that patients feel at ease in the chair.

Patients can book routine check-ups and preventative cleanings to catch problems early, as well as restorative treatment to repair teeth that are already damaged or decayed. The practice aims to offer a comfortable, safe and welcoming setting, making it a good fit for families looking for one dentist close to home in Polokwane. It is at 144 Thabo Mbeki Street.

q-a-services-superbia.description:
Q & A Services is a vehicle repair and service workshop in the Superbia industrial area that specialises in brakes and clutches, two of the systems that matter most for a car's safety. The team diagnoses problems, carries out maintenance and replaces worn parts, from tired brake pads to clutches that have started to slip.

Alongside its brake and clutch work, the workshop's mechanics also handle general mechanical issues, aiming to get each vehicle back on the road safe and roadworthy. It is a practical stop for Polokwane motorists who notice a soft brake pedal, grinding when stopping or a clutch that no longer grips properly. Q & A Services is at 40 Graniet Street in Superbia.

tops-at-spar-paledi-mankweng.description:
TOPS at SPAR Paledi is a bottle store inside Paledi Mall on the R71 in Ga Thoka, Mankweng, popular with locals for its wide range and fair prices. The shelves carry beers, ciders, wines, spirits and liqueurs, giving shoppers plenty of choice whether they are picking up a few drinks for the weekend or stocking up for a larger event.

The store runs regular promotional specials, and customers often mention its competitive pricing and friendly service. Because it trades inside the mall, shoppers can easily add a stop at the bottle store to their usual grocery run. TOPS at SPAR Paledi is at Shop 30 in Paledi Mall, Mankweng.

absa-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Absa Bank's Mall of the North branch serves personal and business clients from the lower level of the mall at the corner of the R81 and N1 bypass. Customers can visit for everyday banking, from opening and managing accounts to deposits and other transactions at the teller counters. Dedicated consultants are on hand to help with more involved needs, including wealth management and business banking for local companies.

For quick cash, the branch has a bank of ATMs on site, and clients can also manage much of their banking digitally through Absa's online and app services. Being inside one of Polokwane's busiest malls makes it convenient to combine a bank visit with shopping. The branch is at Shop L43, Mall of the North, in Bendor.

markham-paledi-mall-mankweng.description:
Markham at Paledi Mall is a branch of the South African menswear and footwear chain, dressing men in Mankweng for work, weekends and special occasions. The store stocks smart-casual and formal clothing with a modern look, from denim and everyday basics to tailored suits and fashionable jackets. A range of contemporary men's shoes sits alongside the clothing, so customers can put together a complete outfit in one visit.

Shoppers can expect an inviting store and friendly service. With the University of Limpopo close by, the branch is a convenient option for students looking for affordable style as well as local professionals needing a suit for the office or a function. Markham is inside Paledi Mall in Turfloop Ext 1, Mankweng.

pj-mathebula-attorneys-bendor.description:
PJ Mathebula Attorneys is a boutique law firm with offices on Pierre Street in Bendor, advising individuals, families and businesses on South African law. The firm's work covers civil litigation and dispute resolution, as well as drafting and reviewing contracts and giving general legal advice, so clients can turn to it both when a dispute arises and when they want to avoid one.

As a smaller practice, the firm takes a personal approach, working closely with each client on their matter and treating every case with strict confidentiality. That suits private clients facing a legal problem for the first time as well as companies needing ongoing advice on their agreements and obligations. PJ Mathebula Attorneys is at 11 Pierre Street, Bendor Ext 30, Polokwane.

seshego-clinic-2-seshego.description:
Seshego Clinic 2, also known as Seshego Zone 2 Clinic, is a public primary healthcare clinic run by the Limpopo Department of Health. For many Seshego residents it is the first place to go when they need medical care, and its services are provided free of charge. Nurses and clinic staff carry out routine health screenings and preventative consultations, monitor patients living with chronic conditions, and offer family planning.

Mothers and young children are a key focus, with maternal and child health services covering pregnancy check-ups and care for babies and toddlers. By treating everyday health needs close to home, the clinic saves residents a trip to the district hospitals and helps keep those hospitals free for more serious cases. The clinic is at Stand 3850 in Seshego-G.

dr-dm-moetlo-mankweng.description:
This dental therapy practice on Mokgobu Street in Zone A, Mankweng, offers preventative and general dental care to families, students and residents of Mankweng and the surrounding communities. Treatment focuses on the essentials of a healthy mouth: professional deep cleans to remove plaque and tartar, fillings to repair cavities, and extractions when a tooth can't be saved.

Patients also get practical advice on brushing, flossing and other daily habits that protect their teeth over the long term, which is especially useful for children and young people. The practice takes a patient-centred approach in a welcoming, comfortable setting, making it an accessible choice for everyday dental check-ups and treatment close to home. It is at Stand 561, Zone A, Mankweng.

dr-gustav-erlank-dentistry-sterpark.description:
This general dental practice in the Bendor Med rooms on Bendor Drive, Sterpark, opened in June 2018 and was founded by a dentist born and raised in Polokwane. Its aim is to make good dental care affordable for the local community, without cutting corners on the quality of treatment. Patients come in for routine check-ups and professional cleans, as well as targeted treatment for specific dental problems.

The practice takes a warm, personal approach, which helps put anxious patients at ease, and spends time explaining each treatment so patients understand how to look after their teeth at home. The practice focuses on building lifelong relationships with its patients to keep their smiles healthy. It is at 30 Bendor Drive in Sterpark, Polokwane.

franco-marx-attorneys-bendor-park.description:
Franco Marx Attorneys is a law firm on Hillary Drive in Bendor that acts for private individuals, companies and larger businesses across Limpopo. Its practice covers family law and divorce litigation, debt collection, estate planning and the administration of trusts, as well as conveyancing and other property matters, so clients can handle a house transfer, a will or a family dispute with the same firm.

The firm describes its approach as practising fearlessly and with integrity, and it combines legal expertise with practical solutions to protect and represent its clients' interests. That makes it a fit both for people going through a divorce or planning their estate and for businesses that need to recover debts or deal with property. Franco Marx Attorneys is at 141 Hillary Drive, Bendor Ext 60, Polokwane.

mamabolo-attorneys-polokwane-central.description:
Mamabolo Attorneys is a law practice on Biccard Street in the Polokwane city centre, serving individuals, small businesses and local companies. The firm works across several areas of law, including civil litigation, criminal defence, family law disputes, contract drafting and the administration of deceased estates, giving clients one practice to turn to for many different legal needs.

Its attorneys combine legal knowledge with an ethical, client-focused way of working, aiming to give practical advice that leads to a clear outcome rather than drawn-out proceedings. Whether someone has been charged with an offence, is dealing with a family matter or needs to wind up a loved one's estate, the firm takes them through the process step by step. Mamabolo Attorneys is at 40 Biccard Street, Polokwane Central.

pick-n-pay-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
Pick n Pay at Mall of the North is a large supermarket on the mall's lower level and one of the bigger grocery stores in the Bendor area. Its spacious aisles carry a wide range of everyday groceries, pantry staples and household goods, so families can do their full weekly shop in one trip.

Fresh food is a strength, with an in-store bakery, a butchery counter, a deli and a broad selection of seasonal fruit and vegetables. Shoppers mention the good value and helpful service, and Smart Shopper members earn points on their purchases that can be put towards future shops. With the rest of the mall around it, the store is an easy place to combine grocery shopping with other errands. Pick n Pay is at Shop L7, Mall of the North, Bendor.

f-and-r-frozen-superbia.description:
F and R Frozen Foods is a frozen food supplier and wholesaler on Rupee Avenue in the Superbia industrial area, selling to both households and businesses. It specialises in frozen groceries, poultry and meat at competitive prices, which makes it popular with families buying in bulk as well as with commercial customers restocking their freezers.

Shoppers often mention the wide selection, from affordable frozen chicken portions to sausages, polony and processed venison. Buying in larger quantities here can help households stretch their monthly food budget. There is plenty of parking on site, which makes it easy to load up a car with a bulk order, and customers describe the service as friendly. F and R Frozen Foods is at 24 Rupee Avenue, Superbia, Polokwane.

mashingo-mokgetheng-polokwane-central.description:
Mashingo Mokgetheng is a law practice on Kerk Street in the commercial heart of Polokwane, giving legal advice and representation to private individuals, families and companies across the region. The firm's services include civil litigation and dispute resolution, drawing up contracts, and advising on estates, covering both disputes that end up in court and the paperwork that helps prevent them.

Each matter is handled ethically and in strict confidence, with advice tailored to the client's situation and focused on a clear result. Its central location makes the office easy to reach for clients working or doing business in town, whether they need help settling a dispute, putting an agreement in writing or planning how their estate will be handled. Mashingo Mokgetheng is at 52 Kerk Street, Polokwane Central.

dr-mm-chokoe-bendor-park.description:
This private general practice on Meteor Avenue in Bendor Park offers GP consultations and primary healthcare for patients of all ages. The practice sees patients for acute illnesses, helps those living with chronic conditions keep them under control, and carries out routine wellness check-ups. Preventative advice is part of every visit, helping patients stay healthy rather than only treating them once they are unwell.

The practice takes a patient-centred approach, giving each person individual attention and compassionate care in a comfortable setting. That makes it a convenient family doctor for households in Bendor Park and the surrounding suburbs, from short-term illnesses to ongoing care. It is at 28 Meteor Avenue, Bendor Park, Polokwane.

lebowa-funeral-parlour-lebowakgomo.description:
Lebowa Funeral Parlour is a funeral services provider in Lebowakgomo that supports families through the loss of a loved one with care and dignity. It offers funeral planning, burial arrangements and cremation services, and works with each family to respect the cultural traditions that matter to them.

The team takes care of the practical details so families don't have to, from sorting out the legal paperwork and preparing the deceased to supplying caskets and coordinating the memorial service on the day. Families can lean on the staff for guidance at every step, from the first call to the final farewell, allowing them to focus on mourning and remembering their loved one. Lebowa Funeral Parlour is at Stand 1996, Unit A, Lebowakgomo.

kiepersol-overnight-accommodation-hospar.description:
Kiepersol Overnight Accommodation is a self-catering guesthouse on Potgieter Street in Hospital Park, a quiet residential suburb of Polokwane. Its location close to the city's main hospitals and the central business area makes it a practical base for people visiting patients or coming in for medical appointments, as well as business travellers and anyone needing a bed for the night.

Guests stay in fully equipped self-catering units, so they can prepare their own meals and come and go independently while still enjoying the welcome of a traditional bed and breakfast. The units are set up for a restful, private stay, and the guesthouse offers a peaceful and secure setting away from the busier parts of town. Kiepersol is at 96 Potgieter Street, Hospital Park.

rite-price-take-away-annadale.description:
Rite Price Take-Away is a local fast-food spot on Witklip Street in Annadale that has been feeding the community since 2005. In more than twenty years of trading, it has built a loyal following for quick, filling meals at prices that suit everyday budgets. The kitchen prepares a range of popular comfort food fresh each day, with generous portions and plenty of flavour.

Orders are placed and collected over the counter, which makes it handy for workers in the surrounding industrial area grabbing lunch on a short break, as well as families and residents picking up an easy meal on the way home. Regulars mention the casual atmosphere and friendly service. Rite Price Take-Away is at 11 Witklip Street, Annadale, Polokwane.

betsekgadi-community-projects-cc-fauna-p.description:
Betsekgadi Community Projects CC is a civil engineering and construction contractor based on Grobler Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane. The close corporation specialises in civil works and concrete construction, taking on infrastructure and structural projects for both public-sector and private clients across Limpopo.

Its work ranges from commercial developments and residential foundations to upgrades of community infrastructure. On each project, the team focuses on durable workmanship, keeping to structural engineering safety standards and delivering on schedule. That makes the company a fit for developers, government departments and property owners who need concrete and civil work done properly, from the ground up, as the province continues to grow. Betsekgadi Community Projects CC operates from 123 Grobler Street, Fauna Park.

frank-phahlane-attorneys-polokwane-centr.description:
Frank Phahlane Attorneys is a law practice on Thabo Mbeki Street, in the part of Polokwane's city centre where many of the town's legal and business offices are found. The firm represents and advises private individuals, families and companies, helping them understand where they stand and what their options are under the law.

Its work covers civil litigation and dispute resolution, the drafting of contracts and general legal advice, so clients can come to the firm before a problem arises as well as once it has. The attorneys pair a solid knowledge of the law with an ethical, client-focused approach, aiming to resolve each matter with as little stress for the client as possible. Frank Phahlane Attorneys is at 20 Thabo Mbeki Street, Polokwane Central.

pep-limpopo-mall-polokwane-central.description:
PEP at Limpopo Mall is a value clothing and homeware store in the Polokwane CBD, part of the chain that describes itself as Africa's largest single-brand retailer. The store sells affordable clothing and footwear for the whole family, from everyday fashion for adults to babywear and essentials for young children. Ahead of each school term, parents can pick up hard-wearing school uniforms at low prices.

Alongside the clothing, PEP stocks home textiles and budget-friendly cellular products, so shoppers can tick off several errands in a single stop. The branch is known for friendly service and low prices that suit central Polokwane shoppers. It is at Shop 47, Limpopo Mall, on the corner of Rissik and Kerk streets.

fnb-mankweng-turfloop-plaza-mankweng.description:
FNB Mankweng is a First National Bank branch in Turfloop Plaza on University Road, serving Mankweng residents, local shoppers and the staff and students of the nearby University of Limpopo. The branch offers a full range of everyday retail banking, from opening an account and keeping it up to date to sitting down with a consultant to talk through finances or credit.

ATMs on site handle day-to-day cash withdrawals and other transactions, and staff can help customers get set up on FNB's digital banking so they can manage their money from their phone between visits. For students living away from home for the first time, having a branch right on their doorstep makes sorting out banking much simpler. FNB Mankweng is at Shop 30, Turfloop Plaza, Mankweng.

pep-cell-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
PEP Cell at Mall@Lebo is a dedicated cellphone store from the PEP group, focused on helping Lebowakgomo shoppers get connected affordably. It stocks a wide choice of budget-friendly feature phones and smartphones, along with SIM cards and starter packs from the major South African networks, so customers can pick up a new phone and get it working in the same visit.

Airtime and data bundles are available over the counter, and the store also carries a range of everyday mobile accessories. With its focus on low prices, PEP Cell suits anyone replacing a lost or broken phone, buying a first handset for a child or simply topping up. The store is at Shop 45, Mall@Lebo, on the corner of the R518 and R579 in Lebowakgomo.

a-m-carrim-attorneys-annadale.description:
A M Carrim & Attorneys is a law firm on Witklip Street in Annadale that specialises in personal injury claims, Road Accident Fund matters and labour law disputes. It acts for individuals who have been injured, for workers in disputes with their employers, and for local businesses that need guidance on employment and other legal issues.

The firm's services include legal advice, help resolving disputes before they escalate, and litigation when a matter has to go to court or a tribunal. Its attorneys combine a thorough knowledge of the law with an empathetic approach, giving each client personal attention and honest advice about their prospects. That makes the firm a natural first call after a road accident, an injury or a problem at work. A M Carrim & Attorneys is at 16 Witklip Street, Annadale.

electric-eel-contractors-cc-flora-park.description:
Electric Eel Contractors CC is an electrical contractor based on Suid Street in Flora Park, working for homeowners, businesses and industrial clients across the greater Polokwane area. Its electricians handle full rewiring of older properties, new electrical installations, fault finding when the power trips or a circuit stops working, and routine maintenance to keep systems running safely.

The company also issues electrical compliance certificates, which are needed when selling a property or after major electrical work. Every job is done in line with safety regulations using quality components, with the aim of preventing hazards and keeping power distribution efficient. Clients can expect a prompt, professional service, whether they need a fault fixed at home or a larger installation on a commercial site. Electric Eel Contractors CC operates from 308 Suid Street, Flora Park.

kids-kingdom-preschool-bendor.description:
Kids Kingdom Preschool is an English-medium pre-school on Wessel Street in Bendor, caring for and teaching children from five months to six years old. It covers the full early childhood stage, from babies in their first year through to children in their final year before formal school.

Children learn through play in a safe, structured and stimulating setting, building social skills, confidence and creative thinking along the way. Qualified teachers follow a well-rounded early learning programme designed to prepare each child for the move to formal schooling. For working parents in Bendor and the surrounding suburbs, the school offers a place where little ones are both looked after and learning every day. Kids Kingdom Preschool is at 137 Wessel Street, Bendor Ext 8, Polokwane.

markham-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
The Markham store at Mall@Lebo brings The Foschini Group's menswear brand to Lebowakgomo, with clothing and shoes for men who want to look sharp at work and relaxed at the weekend. Its rails carry denim and casual everyday wear, smart-casual shirts and trousers, and formal tailored suits, along with contemporary jackets for the cooler months.

A selection of men's footwear lets customers match their shoes to their outfit before they leave the store. Staff are on hand with friendly service, whether a shopper needs a suit for a wedding or interview or just a new pair of jeans, and the range is priced to give good value for money. Markham is at Shop 40, Mall@Lebo, on the corner of the R518 and R579 in Lebowakgomo.

mini-printers-moregloed.description:
Mini Printers is a walk-in print shop in Palm Centre on Grobler Street, Moregloed, serving small businesses, students and residents who need documents done quickly and accurately. Customers can bring in files for black-and-white or full-colour printing, make photocopies, scan documents to digital copies, and have pages bound or laminated while they wait.

The shop works with modern digital equipment to produce clear, sharp prints, whether the job is a CV, an assignment, a set of business forms or marketing material for a small company. Quick turnaround times, friendly service and competitive prices make it a practical stop for everyday printing in central Polokwane. Mini Printers is at Shop 5, Palm Centre, 23 Grobler Street, Moregloed.

ctm-polokwane-nirvana.description:
CTM Polokwane is a branch of the South African tile and bathroomware chain, trading from a spacious showroom on Nelson Mandela Drive in Nirvana. It caters for homeowners renovating a kitchen or bathroom as well as contractors and builders kitting out new homes.

The showroom displays a wide range of floor and wall tiles alongside sanitaryware such as toilets and basins, modern taps, showers and laminate flooring, so customers can see how finishes look together before they buy. Staff give practical advice on choosing the right products for each room and budget, and the store is known for competitive pricing. Whether the project is a single bathroom makeover or a whole house, CTM is a good place to start planning. It is at 64 Nelson Mandela Drive, Polokwane Ext 10.

capitec-bank-paledi-mall-mankweng.description:
Capitec Bank at Paledi Mall offers simple, affordable everyday banking to Mankweng residents, shoppers and students from the nearby university. Inside the branch, friendly consultants help clients open accounts, update their details and sort out day-to-day banking queries, with most transactions handled on a paperless system rather than with forms and slips.

Capitec ATMs at the branch accept cash deposits as well as withdrawals, which is useful for anyone who needs to put money into their account without queuing. Clients can then manage most of their banking through Capitec's digital channels, keeping costs low and giving them close control over their money between visits. Being inside the mall means a trip to the bank fits easily into a regular shopping run. The branch is at Shop 50, Paledi Mall, on the R71 in Ga Thoka, Mankweng.

k-l-engineering-works-ladanna.description:
K L Engineering Works is an automotive engineering and repair workshop on Natrium Street in the Ladanna industrial area, working on both light and heavy vehicles from across the greater Polokwane region. Its engineers and mechanics specialise in engine reconditioning, cylinder head skimming and machining of engine components, as well as more complex mechanical repairs.

The workshop is fitted with specialised machinery for this kind of precision work, which allows it to take on jobs that a general garage often has to send out. Its customers include private motorists, transport and commercial fleet operators, and farmers keeping their vehicles and equipment running. The focus is on accurate, durable workmanship that gets engines and mechanical systems back to reliable working order. K L Engineering Works is at 33 Natrium Street, Ladanna.

laas-attorneys-eduan-park.description:
LAAS Attorneys is a legal practice on Holland Street in Eduan Park, Polokwane. The firm acts for individuals, families and businesses across Limpopo, providing both legal representation and practical advice.

Its services span civil litigation, drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, family law and the administration of deceased estates. That means a business owner can have an agreement drawn up, while a family can get help with a divorce or with winding up a relative's estate, all through the same practice. The attorneys work ethically and keep each client at the centre of their matter, explaining the options clearly and working towards a favourable result with as little stress as possible. LAAS Attorneys is at 138 Holland Street, Eduan Park.

malahlela-attorneys-ivy-park.description:
Malahlela Attorneys is a law firm on Turmeric Street in Ivy Park that serves private individuals, families and businesses in Polokwane and the wider Limpopo region. The practice handles civil litigation and dispute resolution, draws up contracts, and assists with family law matters, covering many of the legal issues people and companies face day to day.

Clients receive personal attention from the attorney handling their matter, and every case is dealt with in complete confidence. The team brings sound legal knowledge and an ethical, client-focused way of working to each brief, with the aim of protecting the client's rights and reaching the best possible result. For residents of Ivy Park and nearby suburbs, it offers legal help without the need to travel into town. Malahlela Attorneys is at 6 Turmeric Street, Ivy Park.

capitec-bank-seshego-circle-seshego.description:
The Capitec Bank branch in Seshego Circle Shopping Centre on Ditlou Street brings straightforward, low-cost banking close to home for Seshego residents and local businesses. Walk-in clients are helped by friendly consultants who can open a new account, link a card, update personal details or resolve problems, and the branch works on paperless processes to keep each visit quick.

For cash, the branch's Capitec ATMs handle both withdrawals and deposits, so shop owners and individuals can bank their money without waiting for a teller. Everyday transactions can then be managed on Capitec's digital banking, which helps clients keep fees down and track their spending. With the centre's other shops around it, residents can take care of their banking and their shopping in a single trip. The branch is at Shop 15, Seshego Circle, Seshego.

mpati-attorneys-ivy-park.description:
Mpati Attorneys is a law firm on Nwanetsi Avenue in Ivy Park Extension 19 that offers general legal services to individuals, families and businesses, with a particular focus on estate planning. The firm helps clients draw up wills that clearly set out their wishes, and assists with setting up and administering trusts, so that their families and assets are protected in the years ahead.

Alongside its estate planning work, the practice advises on a range of everyday legal matters for the local community. Each client receives tailored guidance in strict confidence, backed by solid legal knowledge and an ethical, client-focused approach. For anyone who has been putting off writing a will or wants to set up a family trust, the firm offers a convenient place to start. Mpati Attorneys is at 18 Nwanetsi Avenue, Ivy Park.

pep-cell-mankweng-turfloop-plaza-mankwen.description:
The PEP Cell store in Turfloop Plaza, at the corner of University Street and Hotbosdorp Road, keeps Mankweng residents and University of Limpopo students connected without stretching their budgets. Shoppers can choose from affordable basic handsets and entry-level smartphones, and pick up SIM cards and starter packs for the main South African networks at the same counter.

Topping up is quick, with airtime and data bundles on sale in store, and there is a selection of essential phone accessories for anyone needing a replacement or an extra. For students arriving at the start of the academic year, or anyone whose phone has just broken, the store is a handy first stop to get back online at a low cost. PEP Cell is at Shop 1B, Turfloop Plaza, Mankweng.

happy-feet-daycare-aftercare-westenburg.description:
Happy Feet - Daycare & Aftercare is an early childhood development centre on Grant Street in Westenburg, set up to support working parents. During the day, it offers safe, structured childcare and early learning for toddlers, with a routine that gives little ones a mix of play, learning and rest.

In the afternoons, the centre becomes an aftercare for school-going children, who are given healthy meals, supervised help with their homework and educational activities until their parents collect them. A caring team looks after the children in a secure and stimulating setting, encouraging social skills, emotional growth and confidence in their schoolwork. For Westenburg families juggling work and school runs, it offers dependable care for children of different ages in one place. Happy Feet is at 13 Grant Street, Westenburg.

candykidz-ladanna.description:
CandyKidz is a wholesale and retail store on Silicon Street in Ladanna that supplies sweets, snacks, groceries and catering goods to families and small businesses across Polokwane. Its shelves are packed with sweets, chocolates, chips and other snacks, sold both in everyday quantities and in bulk.

Beyond confectionery, the store stocks bulk groceries, catering supplies and a wide range of packaging, which makes it useful for anyone planning a party or event as well as for tuckshop and spaza owners restocking their shelves. Competitive bulk prices help small traders keep their margins healthy, while families can save by buying party treats in larger quantities. Customers also mention the friendly service. CandyKidz is at 37 Silicon Street, Ladanna, Polokwane.

mizpah-motor-trimmers-superbia.description:
Mizpah Motor Trimmers is an automotive upholstery and trimming workshop on Nikkel Street in the Superbia industrial area. It specialises in repairing vehicle upholstery, re-trimming complete interiors and offering auto valet services, giving tired car interiors a new lease of life.

Its experienced trimmers restore faded or torn seats, replace sagging roof linings and valet interiors until they look close to new, with careful attention to detail on every job. The workshop works for private car owners, businesses with vehicle fleets and classic car enthusiasts restoring older models. By using quality materials and hard-wearing techniques, it improves a vehicle's comfort and appearance, which can also help when the time comes to sell. Mizpah Motor Trimmers is at 3 Nikkel Street, Superbia, Polokwane.

motis-furniture-wholesalers-superbia.description:
Motis Furniture Wholesalers is a furniture and homeware supplier on Nikkel Street in the Superbia industrial area, selling to both furniture retailers and individual buyers. As a wholesaler, it offers a wide selection of furniture at competitive prices, making it a practical source for stores stocking their floors as well as for households and businesses furnishing in bulk.

The range covers office furniture, lounge suites, beds and bedding, and storage units suited to modern homes and workplaces. Delivery is available, which helps with larger and bulkier orders, and customers can expect helpful service from the team when choosing pieces. Whether furnishing a new office, kitting out rental units or restocking a shop, buyers can find good value here. Motis Furniture Wholesalers is at 26 Nikkel Street, Superbia, Polokwane.

sportscene-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
Sportscene at Mall@Lebo is a streetwear and sneaker store from The Foschini Group, aimed at young, trend-conscious shoppers in Lebowakgomo. It stocks authentic sneakers, athletic clothing and streetwear accessories from global brands including Nike, Adidas, Puma and Converse, so customers can pick up a new pair of kicks and an outfit to match in one visit.

New releases and sneaker drops arrive in store regularly, giving local shoppers access to the latest styles without travelling to Polokwane's bigger malls. The store has an upbeat, energetic feel, and the staff offer friendly service. Whether shopping for school, gym or weekend wear, Sportscene keeps the latest street fashion close to home. It is at Shop 41, Mall@Lebo, on the corner of the R518 (Zebediela Road) and R579 (Jane Furse Road).

truworths-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
Truworths at Mall@Lebo is the Lebowakgomo branch of the South African fashion retailer, offering clothing, footwear and accessories for men and women. The store carries a selection of Truworths' own fashion brands, which combine current international trends with local style, from professional workwear and formal outfits to relaxed, smart casual looks for the weekend.

Shoppers come here for quality fabrics and well-made pieces, alongside shoes and accessories to complete an outfit. Staff provide attentive service on the shop floor, and customers can open or use a Truworths account to spread the cost of their purchases. For Lebowakgomo residents who want fashionable clothing for the office, a special occasion or everyday wear without a trip into Polokwane, the store is a convenient option. Truworths is at Shop 16, Mall@Lebo, on the corner of the R518 and R579.

greywies-nu-clean-dry-cleaners-polokwane.description:
Greywies Nu-Clean Dry Cleaners is a long-standing dry cleaner and laundry on Market Street in central Polokwane, well known locally for looking after clothing and household fabrics. It offers dry cleaning, spot treatment for stubborn stains and everyday laundry, so customers can drop off anything from a single shirt to a full bag of washing.

The team uses modern garment-care equipment and fabric-safe detergents to handle delicate items, business suits and heavy winter coats, as well as large household textiles such as duvets and curtains that are hard to wash at home. Quick turnaround times and friendly service make it easy for people working in town to drop off and collect around their day. Greywies Nu-Clean Dry Cleaners is at 02A Market Street, Polokwane Central.

nederduitsch-hervormde-kerk-welgelegen-w.description:
Nederduitsch Hervormde Kerk Welgelegen is a congregation of the Nederduitsch Hervormde Kerk van Afrika (NHKA), meeting on Grimbeek Street in Welgelegen, Polokwane. Rooted in Reformed theology, the church holds regular Sunday worship services and offers spiritual guidance and ministries for the whole family.

Beyond Sunday services, the congregation runs youth programmes that help young members grow in faith, provides pastoral counselling for those going through difficult times, and supports outreach projects that assist people in need in the wider community. Members describe a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere in a peaceful setting, where newcomers and long-standing members alike can find fellowship and grow in their faith. Families looking for a Hervormde congregation in Polokwane will find the church at 83 Grimbeek Street, Welgelegen.

eltasha-guesthouse-spa-dalmada.description:
Eltasha Guesthouse & Spa is a three-star guesthouse on 3rd Street in the quiet smallholding area of Dalmada, on the outskirts of Polokwane. It has 18 individually decorated rooms, each with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV, offering comfortable accommodation at good value for both business and leisure travellers.

Guests can relax beside the outdoor swimming pool or in the garden, and the on-site spa offers Swedish and deep-tissue massages for anyone wanting to unwind after a long drive or a busy day of meetings. There is also a bar and lounge for a drink in the evening, and secure parking on the property. The guesthouse is a short drive from Polokwane's business areas and main shopping centres. Eltasha is at Plot 128, Dalmada AH.

asian-cuisine-cycad-centre-bendor-park.description:
Asian Cuisine is an Indian, Pakistani and Asian fusion restaurant and takeaway in Cycad Centre on General Maritz Street, Bendor Park. It is known for generous portions of aromatic, well-spiced dishes at affordable prices, with a menu that includes rich butter chicken, lamb biryani and tandoori grills cooked in a traditional clay oven.

Diners can sit down in the cosy, welcoming restaurant or order at the counter for a quick takeaway, and meals can also be ordered through local delivery services. The mix of good value and hearty South Asian comfort food makes it a popular choice for families and anyone in Bendor Park craving a curry for lunch or dinner. Asian Cuisine is at Shop 22, Cycad Centre, 114 General Maritz Street, Bendor Park.

great-north-workshop-superbia.description:
