Great North Workshop is a vehicle repair and servicing workshop on Nikkel Street in the Superbia industrial area, looking after cars for private motorists and commercial fleets across the greater Polokwane region. It handles mechanical, electrical and structural repairs, from routine oil changes and full services to engine diagnostics, suspension overhauls and brake repairs.

Experienced technicians use modern diagnostic equipment to track down faults quickly, which saves time and avoids unnecessary guesswork on more complicated problems. Safety comes first on every job, with the aim of returning each vehicle in line with the manufacturer's specifications. For drivers wanting dependable maintenance at a fair cost, or fleet owners who need vehicles back on the road quickly, it is a practical choice. Great North Workshop is at 7 Nikkel Street, Superbia, Polokwane.

morwa-motsho-consulting-engineering-peni.description:
Morwa-Motsho Consulting Engineering is an engineering consultancy based on Mutale Avenue in Penina Park, Polokwane, working on built-environment projects for private developers and public-sector clients. The firm provides structural, civil and infrastructure engineering design, together with project management, so clients can rely on one team to guide a development from start to finish.

Its engineers become involved from the earliest stage, carrying out feasibility studies to test whether a project is viable, then producing the designs and overseeing the work through to structural completion. Designs follow national safety codes and aim to be sustainable, cost-effective and built to last. That makes the firm a good fit for developers, municipalities and businesses planning new buildings or infrastructure as Limpopo continues to grow. Morwa-Motsho Consulting Engineering is at 43 Mutale Avenue, Penina Park.

shoprite-liquorshop-lebowakgomo-lebowakg.description:
Shoprite LiquorShop Lebowakgomo is the Shoprite group's liquor store in Phasha Shopping Centre, at the corner of the R518 and R579. Like the supermarkets, it focuses on keeping prices low, with regular promotional specials that make it easy to stock up without overspending.

The modern, well-organised store carries a broad range of local and imported beers, wines, ciders and spirits, catering for everything from a casual get-together at home to festive celebrations and large family events. Shoppers describe a safe, welcoming environment and friendly staff at the tills. Being inside the shopping centre, it is easy to combine with other errands. Shoprite LiquorShop is inside Phasha Shopping Centre, Lebowakgomo.

dalmada-guesthouse-dalmada.description:
Dalmada Guesthouse is a bed and breakfast on Benharris Street in Dalmada, a quiet agricultural area on the edge of Polokwane. Guests enjoy a calm, rural setting while staying only a short drive from the city's central business district and main shopping malls.

The guesthouse offers comfortable, attractively styled rooms for business travellers, tourists and families who need a restful night away from the noise of town. Each stay includes a freshly prepared breakfast to start the day, and there is secure parking on the property. The hosts' warm hospitality gives the guesthouse a home-from-home feel, making it suitable for a single overnight stop on a long journey north as well as for longer visits. Dalmada Guesthouse is at 36 Benharris Street, Dalmada, Polokwane.

polokwane-towing-futura.description:
Polokwane Towing is a towing and vehicle recovery service based on Corundum Street in Futura, operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The team responds to roadside breakdowns, accident scenes and mechanical failures, helping stranded motorists get themselves and their vehicles safely off the road.

Its fleet of flatbed tow trucks can carry motorcycles, sedans, light commercial vehicles and fleet cars, and each vehicle is secured and handled with care. Beyond local call-outs, the company offers roadside winching for vehicles that have left the road, secure storage for vehicles awaiting repair or assessment, and long-distance towing across Limpopo. For drivers stuck in or around Polokwane at any hour, it provides affordable, dependable help when it matters most. Polokwane Towing is at 37 Corundum Street, Futura.

pro-service-centre-superbia.description:
Pro-Service Centre is a vehicle servicing and repair workshop at the corner of Nikkel Street and Rupee Avenue in Superbia, looking after cars for private owners and businesses with vehicle fleets. Its technicians carry out minor and major logbook services, engine tuning, diagnostics, brake replacements, clutch repairs and suspension overhauls, covering most of what a vehicle needs over its lifetime.

Logbook servicing helps owners keep a full service history, which matters for warranties and resale value. The workshop fits quality replacement parts and keeps its prices competitive, and the team takes care over each job so vehicles leave running smoothly and safely. Fleet managers can bring in several vehicles for regular maintenance, while individual drivers can book in for anything from a routine service to a specific repair. Pro-Service Centre is on the corner of Nikkel Street and Rupee Avenue, Superbia.

madiba-motors-ladanna.description:
Madiba Motors is an independent used-car dealership on Witklip Street in Ladanna that also runs its own mechanical workshop. It sells a range of pre-owned vehicles that are checked before going on the floor, with options to suit different needs and budgets, and buyers come from across Limpopo. Financing options are available to help customers spread the cost of their next car.

What sets the business apart is the fully equipped workshop on site, where skilled technicians carry out engine diagnostics, major and minor services and routine maintenance. That means customers can buy a car and keep it serviced at the same place, building a relationship with a dealer who already knows the vehicle's history. Madiba Motors is at 10 Witklip Street, Ladanna, Polokwane.

skydiva-hair-moregloed.description:
Skydiva Hair is a hair and beauty salon in Palm Centre, at the corner of Hans van Rensburg and Grobler streets in Moregloed. It specialises in natural hair care and wigs, from fitting a new unit so it sits comfortably and looks natural to customising wigs to suit each client's style.

The salon's service menu also includes treatments for relaxed hair, braiding, dreadlock maintenance and weaves, so clients can switch between looks without changing salons. Its stylists are known for creative, on-trend styling and take time to understand what each client wants before they start. The salon has a warm, welcoming atmosphere, and every client gets individual attention whether they come in for a quick touch-up or a full new look. Skydiva Hair is at Shop 4, Palm Centre, Moregloed.

mnc-dental-clinic-lebowakgomo.description:
MNC Dental Clinic is a dental practice inside Mall@Lebo, at the corner of the R518 and R579, providing oral healthcare to families and individuals in Lebowakgomo. The clinic offers preventative, restorative and general dentistry, so most everyday dental needs can be taken care of close to home.

Patients come in for routine check-ups and deep cleans, fillings to repair decayed teeth, and extractions, as well as other treatments aimed at keeping teeth and gums healthy over the long term. The clinic is modern and welcoming, with a calm atmosphere designed to make visits as stress-free as possible. Being in the mall means there is plenty of parking, and an appointment can be combined with shopping or banking. MNC Dental Clinic is at Shop 52A, Mall@Lebo.

phologo-health-care-lebowakgomo.description:
Phologo Health Care is a private clinic in Zone B, Lebowakgomo, that offers both general medical care and dentistry under one roof. On the medical side, the clinical team sees patients for acute illnesses, monitors chronic conditions, carries out routine health screenings and gives advice on staying well.

The clinic's dental unit handles check-ups, cleanings and restorative treatment, so families can look after their general health and their teeth at the same practice instead of visiting two separate providers. Care is patient-centred and delivered in a modern setting, with staff taking time to treat each person with compassion. For households across the greater Lebowakgomo area, it is an accessible option for everyday healthcare close to home. Phologo Health Care is at Stand 2678, Zone B, Lebowakgomo.

mr-price-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
Mr Price at Savannah Mall is a branch of the South African value-fashion chain, selling affordable clothing, footwear and accessories for the whole family from a spacious store in Fauna Park. The rails are refreshed with each season's trends, so shoppers can keep up with current styles without spending much.

The range covers everyday casual wear, denim and activewear for men and women, along with a kids' department with clothes for babies and children. Shoes and accessories sit alongside the clothing, making it easy to put together a complete look in one visit. The store has a lively, energetic feel, and its low prices make it a regular stop for families and young shoppers on a budget. Mr Price is at Shop 30, Savannah Mall, on the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki streets.

pep-cell-seshego-circle-seshego.description:
PEP Cell in Seshego Circle Shopping Centre on Ditlou Street is a phone shop from the PEP group that makes mobile technology affordable for Seshego residents. Customers can browse low-cost cellphones and smartphones, and buy SIM cards and starter packs for all the major networks, making it simple to switch networks or set up a second line.

Airtime and data can be bought at the counter whenever a top-up is needed, and the store keeps a range of essential accessories for keeping phones charged and protected. Its value pricing suits households who need a reliable phone without a contract or a large upfront cost. With everything needed to get and stay connected in one small store, PEP Cell is a handy stop during a trip to the centre. It is at Shop 12, Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, Seshego.

pep-seshego-plaza-seshego.description:
PEP at Seshego Plaza on New Era Drive is a branch of the value retailer that bills itself as Africa's largest single-brand chain, bringing low-priced clothing and household basics to Seshego families. The store stocks everyday fashion and footwear for men, women and children, along with babywear for the youngest members of the family.

When a new school year approaches, parents can find sturdy, affordable school uniforms here, and the store also sells home textiles and budget cellular products. Having all of these under one roof lets shoppers cover clothing, home and phone needs in a single visit. Friendly staff and consistently low prices make it a practical everyday store for the community. PEP is at Shop 17, Seshego Plaza, New Era Drive, Seshego.

amigos-liquor-store-flora-park.description:
Amigos Liquor Store is a neighbourhood bottle store on Marshall Street in Flora Park, popular with locals for its range and its prices. The well-organised shelves hold local and imported beers, wines, ciders and spirits, so customers can find their usual brand or try something new.

Competitive prices and regular promotions help shoppers get good value, whether they are buying a few drinks for the weekend, stocking up for a social gathering or catering for a big festive event. Service over the counter is quick and efficient, and customers describe a friendly, secure place to shop without any hassle. For Flora Park residents, it offers a convenient bottle store right in the neighbourhood rather than a trip to one of the malls. Amigos Liquor Store is at 222 Marshall Street, Flora Park, Polokwane.

engen-everon-filling-station-lebowakgomo.description:
Engen Everon Filling Station is an Engen fuel station on the R579 at Metlife Plaza in Lebowakgomo, open 24 hours a day for local commuters and long-distance travellers. Attendants at the pumps fill up with petrol or diesel and offer friendly forecourt service, helping drivers get back on the road quickly.

The on-site Engen Quickshop is stocked with snacks, hot drinks and travel essentials, so motorists can pick up something to eat or drink while they refuel, whether early in the morning or late at night. Its position on the busy R579 makes it a convenient stop for people heading in and out of Lebowakgomo, as well as for residents filling up on their way to work. Engen Everon is at Metlife Plaza, R579, Lebowakgomo-BA.

hamba-buya-tours-westenburg.description:
Hamba Buya Tours is a passenger transport and tour hire company based on Ben Harris Street in Westenburg, Polokwane, specialising in chartered bus hire for groups. Its buses carry schools on educational excursions, companies heading to team-building retreats, church groups travelling to services and gatherings, and private groups on leisure tours across South Africa.

The fleet can accommodate groups of different sizes, from a small party to a large group travelling together. Vehicles are regularly maintained, and the company puts passenger safety and punctuality first, so organisers can plan their day knowing the bus will be there on time. For anyone arranging transport for a group, it offers a comfortable and dependable way to travel without the hassle of coordinating several cars. Hamba Buya Tours is at 4 Ben Harris Street, Westenburg.

pep-stores-metlife-plaza-lebowakgomo.description:
The PEP store in Metlife Plaza, at the corner of the R518 Zebediela road and the R579, gives Lebowakgomo families an affordable place to shop for clothing, shoes and home basics. It is part of PEP, the chain that describes itself as Africa's largest single-brand retailer, and its low prices are aimed at households watching every rand.

Inside, shoppers will find casual everyday clothing for the whole family, babywear and footwear, plus hard-wearing school uniforms that are in demand at the start of every school year. Home textiles and inexpensive cellular products round out the range. Friendly staff help customers find what they need, and the mix of products means one stop can cover several items on a family's shopping list. PEP is at Shop 7A, Metlife Plaza, Lebowakgomo.

standard-bank-mankweng-service-centre-ma.description:
Standard Bank Mankweng Service Centre is a Standard Bank branch in Tintis Square on University Road, serving Mankweng residents, local businesses and the University of Limpopo community next door. It offers a full range of everyday retail banking, from opening and managing accounts to collecting new or replacement bank cards.

Consultants on site give financial advice and help clients get started with Standard Bank's digital banking, so they can do more of their banking from their phones between visits. ATMs at the centre handle day-to-day cash needs. Students setting up their first bank account, shoppers at Tintis Square and residents who prefer to deal with someone face to face can all get help here from friendly, efficient staff. The service centre is at 614 University Road, Tintis Square, Mankweng.

fastway-couriers-futura.description:
Fastway Couriers Polokwane is a locally owned courier depot on Corundum Street in Futura, handling parcel deliveries and pickups across the Limpopo region. It serves online stores, businesses and private individuals who need to send parcels reliably and at a reasonable cost.

Fastway's prepaid label system makes domestic shipping simple, which suits businesses sending parcels regularly. Deliveries are carried out by the depot's team of franchise couriers, and every parcel can be tracked online so both sender and recipient know where it is. With a focus on secure handling and quick turnaround times, the depot is a practical shipping partner for local e-commerce sellers and companies. Fastway Couriers is at 53 Corundum Street, Futura, Polokwane.

laundry-dynamics-thornhill-thornhill-est.description:
Laundry Dynamics is a dry-cleaning and laundry service in Thornhill Shopping Centre, at the corner of Munnik Avenue and Veldspaat Street, catering for local residents and busy working professionals. Customers drop off everything from everyday clothing to formal wear and business suits, as well as bulky household items such as duvets and curtains that are hard to wash at home.

The team handles delicate garments with care, using modern washing equipment and eco-friendly detergents to get items clean and fresh. Turnaround times are quick, so suits and work clothes are ready when they are needed, and the staff are friendly and helpful at the counter. For Thornhill households short on time, dropping washing off during a visit to the centre takes one more chore off the list. Laundry Dynamics is at Shop 49, Thornhill Shopping Centre.

dr-annchen-gerritsen-polokwane-central.description:
This general practitioner consults at Medpark Family Practice, a long-established group medical practice on Jorissen Street in central Polokwane. Working within a group practice means patients benefit from a well-run medical setting, while still seeing a doctor who gets to know them and their history over time.

Consultations cover the full scope of family medicine for patients of all ages, from children to older adults. Patients can be seen for acute illnesses that need prompt attention, get ongoing support in managing chronic conditions, and book routine check-ups and preventative advice to stay well. Care is individual and compassionate, delivered in a comfortable consulting room with time taken to listen. For families in and around the city centre looking for a regular GP, the practice is easy to reach. Medpark Family Practice is at 24 Jorissen Street, Polokwane.

dr-mark-melville-polokwane-central.description:
This family doctor is based at Medpark Family Practice on Jorissen Street, an established group practice in Polokwane Central. He provides general medical consultations and primary healthcare for patients of every age, making him a convenient choice for families who want one GP for everyone in the household.

Day-to-day work includes diagnosing and treating acute illnesses, helping patients manage long-term chronic conditions, and carrying out routine health assessments. Preventative guidance is part of each consultation, giving patients practical steps to protect their health before problems develop. The approach combines careful clinical work with a personal, patient-centred manner, so people feel heard and understand their treatment. Patients can book at Medpark Family Practice, 24 Jorissen Street, in the centre of Polokwane.

dr-pieter-vermeulen-polokwane-central.description:
This general practitioner sees patients at Medpark Family Practice, a well-established group practice at 24 Jorissen Street in Polokwane Central. He offers primary healthcare and medical consultations for the whole family, from young children through to older patients.

When someone falls ill, he diagnoses and treats acute conditions, while patients living with chronic illnesses can rely on regular follow-ups to keep their health stable. Routine physical examinations and preventative healthcare advice help patients catch problems early and stay well for longer. Care is compassionate and patient-centred, delivered from the practice's modern rooms in the city centre. Bookings are made through Medpark Family Practice on Jorissen Street.

dr-veronica-stopforth-polokwane-central.description:
This GP is part of the team at Medpark Family Practice, the group practice on Jorissen Street in Polokwane Central. She sees individuals and families of all ages, tailoring each consultation to the patient in front of her.

Her consultations cover the treatment of short-term illnesses, ongoing management of chronic conditions, and routine wellness screenings. She also places weight on health education, explaining how patients can prevent illness and look after themselves between visits. Patients can expect a caring, patient-centred approach backed by sound clinical knowledge, and the reassurance of a doctor who takes a personal interest in their wellbeing. Appointments can be made with Medpark Family Practice at 24 Jorissen Street, Polokwane.

truworths-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
The Truworths store at Savannah Mall in Fauna Park sells fashion clothing, shoes and accessories for men and women from the well-known South African chain. Its rails feature Truworths' own labels, which pair current international trends with a local sense of style, so shoppers can find pieces that feel up to date without looking out of place in Polokwane.

The range runs from smart workwear and formal outfits for the office or special occasions to casual looks for weekends, with an emphasis on good-quality fabrics. Footwear and accessories help complete each outfit. Staff on the floor are helpful and attentive, and customers can buy on a Truworths account if they prefer to pay over time. Truworths is at Shop 29, Savannah Mall, on the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki streets, Fauna Park.

absa-bank-turfloop-plaza-mankweng.description:
Absa Bank Turfloop Plaza is a full-service Absa branch on University Road in Mankweng, serving local residents, shoppers and the staff and students of the University of Limpopo close by. It provides the everyday banking most people need, from opening and managing accounts to talking through finances with a consultant.

Clients can apply for loans in the branch and get help setting up and using Absa's digital banking, which lets them handle routine transactions from their phones. ATMs at the branch take care of quick cash needs, and the consultants offer efficient, friendly help with more involved queries. For students opening an account for the first time, or residents who prefer face-to-face banking, the branch is a convenient option in the heart of Mankweng. It is at Shop E2, Turfloop Plaza.

gabaza-security-services-hospark.description:
Gabaza Security Services is a private security company based on Devenish Street in Hospital Park, providing guarding and protection services across Polokwane. It works with homeowners, businesses and industrial sites, tailoring the level of security to each property.

Its security officers are trained and vetted before deployment, and they handle access control at gates and entrances, protect clients' assets and patrol property perimeters on a regular schedule. The company takes a proactive approach, planning security around each site's particular risks rather than only reacting to incidents, and aims to respond quickly when something goes wrong. For a business that needs guards at its premises or a homeowner wanting peace of mind, the firm offers dependable, vigilant protection from a local team. Gabaza Security Services is at 9 Devenish Street, Hospital Park, Polokwane.

northern-forklifts-futura.description:
Northern Forklifts (Pty) Ltd is a materials-handling business on Chroom Street in the Futura industrial area that sells, services and repairs forklifts for companies across Limpopo. Its customers include warehouses, logistics operators, farms and manufacturers who rely on forklifts to keep goods moving every day.

Alongside forklift sales, the company carries out scheduled mechanical servicing and responds quickly to breakdowns, helping clients keep downtime to a minimum. For businesses facing busy periods, such as harvest season on farms or peak months in a warehouse, forklifts can be rented seasonally or hired for shorter terms instead of buying an extra machine. Safety and dependable machine performance are at the centre of its work. Northern Forklifts is at 33 Chroom Street, Futura, Polokwane.

pick-n-pay-local-polokwane-crescent-nirv.description:
Pick n Pay Local Polokwane Crescent is a neighbourhood-sized Pick n Pay on The Crescent Drive, near Tagore Street in Nirvana, set up for quick, easy shopping close to home. Rather than a full-size supermarket, it focuses on the things households buy most often, with an emphasis on freshness.

Shoppers will find fresh fruit and vegetables, daily bakery goods, pantry staples and everyday household items, enough for a quick top-up after work or a regular grocery run. The smaller layout makes it fast to get in and out, and tills move quickly with friendly staff. Smart Shopper members earn points on their purchases, adding extra value to everyday shopping. For Nirvana residents, it saves a drive to the bigger malls for the basics. Pick n Pay Local is at 139 The Crescent Drive, Nirvana.

sleepmasters-paledi-mankweng.description:
The Sleepmasters showroom in Paledi Mall is the Mankweng branch of the national bed and mattress chain, focused on helping customers sleep better. Shoppers can try out a wide selection of beds and supportive mattresses from well-known brands, and pick up pillows and bedroom accessories to go with them.

In-store sleep consultants help each customer find the right mattress for how they sleep and what they can spend, rather than pushing a one-size-fits-all option. Prices are competitive, and buyers can choose credit options to spread the cost of a new bed. Once a purchase is made, the store can arrange delivery, which takes the hassle out of getting a bulky bed home. For Mankweng households replacing a tired mattress or furnishing a new bedroom, it is a convenient local choice. Sleepmasters is at Shop 24, Paledi Mall, Mankweng.

barloworld-equipment-ladanna.description:
Barloworld Equipment's Polokwane branch on Pietersburg Street in Ladanna is the local outlet of the official Caterpillar dealer, supplying heavy machinery to the construction, mining and earthmoving industries in the region. Contractors and mines can buy earthmoving equipment here and source genuine Cat replacement parts to keep their machines running.

Factory-trained field technicians, supported by modern diagnostic tools, carry out mechanical servicing and repairs, helping customers avoid costly breakdowns and keep their equipment working. The team also offers fleet management support, helping larger operators plan maintenance and get the most out of their machines over time. For large projects across Limpopo, from road building to mining operations, the branch is a key source of equipment and backup. Barloworld Equipment is at 83 Pietersburg Street, Ladanna, Polokwane.

pep-home-mankweng.description:
PEP Home at Paledi Mall is the homeware arm of the PEP retail group, offering affordable ways to furnish and freshen up a home in Mankweng. The store focuses on stylish pieces at low prices, so customers can update a bedroom, lounge or kitchen without spending a lot.

Its colourful range includes bedding and linen, curtains, kitchenware and everyday household items, along with small furniture pieces and decor accessories that add a finishing touch to a room. It is a handy stop for students setting up a first flat near the university, newlyweds furnishing a home or anyone wanting a quick change of look. Staff are friendly and the discount prices make it easy to buy several items in one visit. PEP Home is at Shop 49, Paledi Mall, on the R71 in Mankweng.

goldwagen-polokwane-superbia.description:
Goldwagen Polokwane is a vehicle parts and accessories store on Nikkel Street in Superbia, part of the national Goldwagen auto-parts chain. It supplies affordable, good-quality replacement parts for a wide range of popular vehicle makes, serving both everyday motorists and local mechanics and workshops.

The shelves cover engine components, brake parts, suspension, filters and electrical parts, along with lubricants and oils for routine servicing. Knowledgeable staff behind the counter help customers find the right part for their vehicle, which saves time and avoids costly mistakes, and the store is known for having parts in stock when they are needed. Whether a driver is doing their own service at home or a mechanic needs a part to finish a job, the branch helps keep vehicles safe and running well. Goldwagen is at 1 Nikkel Street, Superbia, Polokwane.

lekola-kgerele-optometrist-mankweng.description:
Lekola Kgerele Optometrist is an optometry practice at Unit C, Stand 237 in Mankweng, providing eye care for patients of all ages. The practice carries out thorough eye examinations to check how well patients see and to pick up common vision problems, then fits prescription lenses where they are needed.

Patients also receive guidance on managing a range of vision conditions and on looking after their eyes over the long term. Once a prescription has been confirmed, they can choose from a selection of fashionable spectacle frames or be fitted for contact lenses. Care is patient-centred and friendly, with time taken to explain results and options. For Mankweng residents, it means professional eye care and new glasses close to home rather than in town. Lekola Kgerele Optometrist is at Stand 237, Unit C, Mankweng, Polokwane.

pep-seshego-circle-seshego.description:
This PEP branch in Seshego Circle Shopping Centre on Ditlou Street keeps everyday clothing and home essentials within easy reach of Seshego households. As part of PEP, which calls itself Africa's largest single-brand retailer, it focuses on low prices so families can buy what they need without stretching the month's budget.

The store carries casual clothing and shoes for adults and children, baby clothes and basics, and long-lasting school uniforms for the new school year. Home textiles and low-cost cellular products are also on offer, which means shoppers can cover several needs in the same visit. Staff are friendly and helpful, and the store is a regular stop for many residents when they do their shopping at the centre. PEP is at Shop 8, Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, Seshego.

tops-at-spar-flora-park-flora-park.description:
TOPS at SPAR Flora Park is the liquor store attached to the SPAR supermarket in Flora Park Shopping Centre on Marshall Street. Being right next to the supermarket, it lets shoppers pick up drinks during their regular grocery run without making a separate trip.

The store is well stocked with beers, ciders, wines, spirits and liqueurs, covering popular everyday brands as well as bottles for special occasions. Competitive prices and regular promotions help customers get good value, whether they are buying for a quiet evening at home or a bigger celebration. Shoppers describe friendly service at the till and a secure, hassle-free place to buy their drinks. For Flora Park residents, it is a convenient neighbourhood bottle store close to home. TOPS at SPAR is in Flora Park Shopping Centre, 293 Marshall Street.

vodacom-seshego-circle-seshego.description:
Vodacom Seshego Circle is a Vodacom store in Seshego Circle Shopping Centre on Ditlou Street, bringing the network's full range of mobile services to Seshego residents. Customers can browse the latest smartphones, sign up for or upgrade a contract, and buy prepaid SIM cards and data bundles over the counter.

Consultants in store help customers choose the right device and plan, and assist with technical problems on phones and accounts. When a device needs fixing, the store can help arrange repairs, and it stocks a wide range of quality accessories. For residents who want to sort out an upgrade, a new line or a phone problem without travelling into Polokwane, the store offers everything in one place. Vodacom is at Shop 14, Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, Seshego.

japie-visser-pharmacy-moregloed.description:
Japie Visser Pharmacy is a long-standing community pharmacy on Grobler Street in central Polokwane, known for its personal, neighbourly service. Its pharmacists dispense prescription medicines, carry out basic health screenings and give professional advice, making the pharmacy a first stop for many families when a health question comes up.

Besides prescriptions, the shelves hold over-the-counter remedies, vitamins and supplements, and everyday personal care products, so customers can collect their medication and pick up other essentials in one visit. Customers value the warm welcome, the knowledgeable pharmacists and the efficient service at the counter, where staff take time to explain how to use each medicine. For people living and working in the city centre, it offers dependable, personal pharmacy care close at hand. Japie Visser Pharmacy is at 17 Grobler Street, Polokwane.

nedbank-mall-of-the-north-bendor.description:
The Nedbank branch on the upper level of Mall of the North in Bendor is a full-service branch for personal and business banking. Residents, shoppers and local business owners can open and manage accounts, handle transactions at the teller counters and collect new or replacement bank cards from the card collection point.

Consultants are available for more detailed conversations, including wealth management, while Nedbank ATMs on site take care of quick withdrawals and other everyday transactions. Clients can also handle much of their day-to-day banking through Nedbank's digital channels, using the branch for anything that needs a face-to-face conversation. Its spot inside one of Polokwane's largest malls makes it easy to fit a bank visit into a shopping trip. Nedbank is at Shop U1, Mall of the North, Munnik Avenue, Bendor.

evp-internet-cafe-seshego-zone-1.description:
EVP Internet Cafe on Chris Hani Drive in Seshego Zone 1 gives local residents affordable access to the internet and computers. Customers can use modern workstations with fast internet access, paying by the hour, which helps people who don't have a computer or reliable data at home stay connected.

The cafe also handles everyday document work, including printing, photocopying, scanning and laminating. Staff are friendly and knowledgeable, and help customers with tasks such as applying for jobs online, completing university and college registrations, and sending and receiving emails. That makes it a valuable stop for students, job seekers and residents who need to get something done online but aren't sure where to start. EVP Internet Cafe is on Chris Hani Drive, Seshego Zone 1, Polokwane.

engen-tele-service-station-seshego.description:
Engen Tele Service Station on Chris Hani Drive is an Engen garage serving Seshego around the clock, 24 hours a day. Local commuters and travellers passing through can fill up with petrol or diesel, with attendants on the forecourt providing quick, friendly service so drivers are not kept waiting.

Inside, the Engen Quickshop sells snacks, hot drinks and travel essentials, handy for a coffee on the morning commute or a late-night top-up of supplies. The shop is secure and well stocked, so motorists can pick up what they need while their tank is being filled. Its location on one of Seshego's main roads makes it an easy stop for residents heading to work or into Polokwane, at any time of day or night. Engen Tele is at 126 Chris Hani Drive, Seshego.

old-mutual-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
Old Mutual at Mall@Lebo is a branch of the pan-African financial services group, helping Lebowakgomo families and businesses plan and protect their finances. Clients can sit down with a certified financial adviser to talk through their goals and put together a plan that suits their income and circumstances.

The branch offers life assurance and funeral cover to protect loved ones, investment plans for building savings, and retirement products for people preparing for life after work. Personal loans are also available for those who need to cover larger expenses. Advice is personal and professional, with advisers explaining each product clearly so clients understand what they are signing up for. For residents who want face-to-face financial guidance close to home, the office is easy to reach while shopping at the mall. Old Mutual is at Shop 48, Mall@Lebo, Lebowakgomo.

shoprite-liquorshop-seshego-seshego.description:
Shoprite LiquorShop Seshego is the Shoprite group's bottle store in Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, at the corner of Nelson Mandela Drive and Polokwane Drive. It brings the group's low-price approach to drinks, with regular specials that help Seshego customers stretch their money further.

On the shelves, shoppers will find a wide choice of local and imported beers, wines, ciders and spirits, covering both popular favourites and bottles for special occasions. Whether stocking up for a family braai, a weekend get-together or a large festive celebration, customers can usually find what they need in one visit. The modern store has a safe, welcoming feel, and the staff are friendly and helpful at the counter. Shoprite LiquorShop is at Shop 19, Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, Seshego.

woolworths-the-greenery-polokwane-centra.description:
Woolworths The Greenery is a branch of the well-known South African retailer inside The Greenery Mall on Oost Street, Polokwane Central. The store combines a Woolworths food market with clothing, footwear and homeware, so shoppers can do their grocery shopping and browse fashion in the same visit.

The food section is known for its fresh produce, including organic options, as well as ready-prepared meals for busy weeknights and a range of quality groceries and speciality items. Elsewhere in the store, customers will find contemporary clothing and shoes, along with homeware to refresh a living space. The modern, well-designed store is easy to shop, and staff are known for helpful service. For residents who value quality food and fashion in central Polokwane, it is a convenient choice. Woolworths is at The Greenery Mall, 54 Oost Street, Polokwane.

absa-bank-seshego.description:
Absa Bank Seshego is an Absa branch on Kwena Moloto Street that provides everyday banking for Seshego residents, shoppers and local businesses. Customers can visit the teller counters for deposits, withdrawals and other transactions, or sit down with a consultant to open an account or sort out changes to an existing one.

The branch also takes loan applications and helps clients get set up on Absa's digital banking, so they can make payments and check balances from their phones instead of queuing. ATMs at the branch accept cash deposits as well as handling withdrawals, which is convenient for business owners banking their takings. Staff are friendly and efficient, making it a dependable local branch for anyone who prefers to bank in person close to home. Absa is at 52 Kwena Moloto Street, Seshego.

jungle-buddies-preschool-sterpark.description:
Jungle Buddies Preschool is a pre-primary school on Juno Avenue in Sterpark, Polokwane, where early learning is built on Christian values. It cares for and teaches toddlers and young children, giving them a warm, nurturing start to their education.

Days are structured and stimulating, with learning through play at the heart of the programme. Children develop social skills by learning to share, take turns and make friends, while creative activities encourage them to think, imagine and express themselves. Qualified teachers follow a well-rounded, values-based early learning curriculum designed to get each child ready for primary school. Parents looking for a caring, faith-based preschool in Sterpark and the surrounding suburbs will find it at 40 Juno Avenue.

belta-services-futura.description:
Belta Services is a mechanical and electrical engineering contractor based on Lood Street in the Futura industrial area, working for industrial and commercial clients across Polokwane and Limpopo. The company handles the engineering side of keeping factories, plants and commercial buildings running, from putting new systems in place to keeping existing ones in good order.

Its work includes installing machinery, setting up heavy electrical systems, carrying out preventative mechanical maintenance and fabricating custom parts and structures to suit a client's needs. Experienced technicians work to national safety standards with industrial-grade equipment, aiming to finish each job accurately and keep the client's downtime as short as possible. For businesses that need dependable engineering support to keep operations efficient, Belta Services offers a local team that can take on both installation and upkeep. It operates from 44 Lood Street, Futura, Polokwane.

fanus-de-beer-ingelyf-bendor.description:
Fanus de Beer Ingelyf is an accounting and auditing practice in Pro Park on Bendor Drive, Bendor, serving private individuals, small and medium-sized businesses and larger local companies. The firm helps clients meet South Africa's financial and tax requirements while keeping a clear picture of how their business is performing.

Its services include independent statutory audits, company tax compliance, bookkeeping and the compilation of annual financial statements, as well as broader business advice for owners looking to improve their results. Clients can hand over the day-to-day numbers and the year-end requirements to one practice, freeing them to focus on running their business. The team works ethically and keeps each client's needs at the centre of the engagement. Fanus de Beer Ingelyf is at 2A Pro Park, 29 Bendor Drive, Bendor, Polokwane.

spar-polokwane-cbd-polokwane-central.description:
Spar Polokwane CBD is a supermarket on Biccard Street in the centre of Polokwane, serving people who live and work in town as well as commuters passing through. It keeps everyday essentials close at hand, so shoppers can pick up what they need during a lunch break or on the way home.

The store has a good selection of fresh fruit and vegetables, an in-store bakery for fresh bread and baked goods, and a full-service butchery counter, alongside pantry staples and household goods. Checkouts move quickly, prices are competitive and the staff are friendly, which suits city-centre shoppers who are short on time. Spar Polokwane CBD is at 47 Biccard Street, Polokwane Central.

virtual-bookkeeping-graphic-design-eduan.description:
Virtual Bookkeeping & Graphic Design is a two-in-one service business on Steyn Street in Eduan Park that looks after both the books and the brand for small and medium-sized businesses and local entrepreneurs. Much of the work is done remotely, so clients can stay focused on running their business while the paperwork and design are handled for them.

On the bookkeeping side, the team manages monthly invoicing, bank reconciliations, expense tracking and payroll, helping businesses keep accurate records and stay compliant. The design side produces logos, corporate branding, social media graphics and promotional material such as flyers and adverts. Having both under one roof gives growing businesses a cost-effective way to get their finances in order and present a professional image at the same time. The business is at 109 Steyn Street, Eduan Park, Polokwane.

mini-sushi-cycad-centre-bendor-park.description:
Mini Sushi is a Chinese and sushi takeaway in Cycad Centre on General Maritz Street, Bendor Park, popular with locals for generous portions at affordable prices. The menu brings together Chinese favourites such as sweet and sour pork and chow mein with freshly made sushi, including California rolls, fashion sandwiches and sushi platters for sharing.

Orders are taken over the counter and prepared quickly using fresh ingredients, making it an easy option for a weeknight dinner or a quick lunch. Meals can also be ordered through local delivery services for anyone who would rather eat at home. With both Chinese dishes and sushi on one menu, it suits families and groups who can't agree on what to eat. Mini Sushi is at Shop 15, Cycad Centre, 114 General Maritz Street, Bendor Park.

mr-price-mall-lebo-lebowakgomo.description:
The Mr Price store at Mall@Lebo brings the value-fashion chain's clothing, shoes, accessories and homeware to Lebowakgomo, all at everyday low prices. The spacious store is laid out so families can shop for everyone in one go, from adults to young children.

New seasonal styles arrive regularly, with casual everyday clothing, denim and activewear on the rails alongside a kids' section full of bright, affordable outfits. Shoes and accessories help finish a look, and a range of trendy homeware lets shoppers refresh a room as well as their wardrobe. The store has a busy, upbeat atmosphere and its prices keep current fashion within reach of most budgets, which makes it a regular stop for local shoppers. Mr Price is at Shop 11, Mall@Lebo, on the corner of the R518 and R579, Lebowakgomo.

numberplate-and-key-centre-ladanna.description:
Numberplate and Key Centre is a locksmith and vehicle-services business on Witklip Street in Ladanna that helps motorists and property owners with keys, locks and number plates. Customers can have keys cut accurately for homes, offices and vehicles, and call on the team for a range of other locksmith services.

The centre also makes compliant vehicle number plates, which drivers need after buying a car, changing registration or replacing a damaged plate. On top of that, it helps customers renew their vehicle licences online, saving them a trip and a queue at the licensing office. Turnaround times are quick, prices are competitive and the staff are friendly and helpful, so a single visit can take care of several jobs at once. Numberplate and Key Centre is at 21 Witklip Street, Ladanna, Polokwane.

ackermans-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
Ackermans at Savannah Mall is a double-unit store in Fauna Park from the national value chain, selling affordable clothing, footwear and homeware for the whole family. It is best known for its large baby and children's departments, where parents can find hard-wearing everyday outfits for little ones at prices that suit a growing family's budget.

Alongside the kids' range, the store stocks casual clothing for adults, shoes and school uniforms, so back-to-school shopping can be done in one place. A selection of homeware completes the offer. Shoppers who would rather pay over time can use Ackermans' lay-by, and the staff are friendly and helpful on the shop floor. For Fauna Park and nearby suburbs, it is a practical stop for dressing the family without overspending. Ackermans is at Shops 84 and 85, Savannah Mall, on the corner of Thabo Mbeki and Grimm streets.

engen-wins-motors-annadale.description:
Engen Wins Motors on Witklip Street in Annadale is more than a filling station: alongside its Engen forecourt, it runs a fully equipped vehicle workshop. Drivers can fill up with petrol or diesel, with attendants providing quick, friendly service at the pumps, and pick up snacks and drinks from the shop on site.

The workshop's skilled mechanics carry out car services, mechanical repairs and routine engine maintenance, so motorists can have their vehicle looked at in the same place they buy fuel. That makes it handy for people who work in the surrounding industrial area, who can drop a car off for a service and collect it after work. For Annadale and Ladanna drivers, it combines refuelling and vehicle care at one convenient stop. Engen Wins Motors is at 15 Witklip Street, Annadale, Polokwane.

larciano-rekenmeesters-bendor.description:
Larciano Rekenmeesters is an accounting practice on Bendor Avenue in Bendor, Polokwane, working with individuals, small and medium-sized businesses and larger local companies. The firm takes care of the financial administration that keeps a business compliant with South African tax and reporting rules, as well as offering advice on how to improve results.

Clients can rely on the practice for bookkeeping, monthly management accounts that show how the business is tracking, tax returns and compliance for both companies and individuals, and the compilation of annual financial statements. Business consulting helps owners strengthen the financial health of their business. The accountants combine solid technical knowledge with an ethical, personal approach, so clients understand their numbers rather than just receiving them. Larciano Rekenmeesters is at 29 Bendor Avenue, Bendor, Polokwane.

mr-price-paledi-mall-mankweng.description:
Mr Price at Paledi Mall is Mankweng's branch of the value-fashion chain, popular with families and with students from the nearby University of Limpopo who want to keep up with trends on a tight budget. The roomy store stocks clothing, shoes, accessories and homeware at low everyday prices.

Shoppers can choose from the latest seasonal styles, including casual everyday wear, jeans and activewear for gym or campus, and a kids' range of affordable outfits for younger family members. Accessories add the finishing touches, while the homeware section offers inexpensive ways to brighten up a room or student residence. The store has a lively feel and turns over new stock regularly, so there is usually something fresh to see on each visit. Mr Price is at Shop 57, Paledi Mall, on the R71 in Mankweng.

bendor-builders-bendor.description:
Bendor Builders is a construction company based on Morris Street in Bendor that has been building in and around Polokwane for more than 30 years. Over three decades it has taken on a wide variety of projects, earning a reputation for solid workmanship and reliable delivery.

Its work ranges from custom-built family homes and upmarket renovations to larger commercial developments. The team works closely with architects and property owners, turning approved plans into finished buildings. Quality materials and strict safety standards on site help make sure each structure is built to last. For homeowners planning a new house or major renovation, or developers looking for an experienced local contractor, the company brings decades of hands-on building experience. Bendor Builders is at 1 Morris Street, Bendor, Polokwane.

sasol-penina-park-penina-park.description:
Sasol Penina Park is a Sasol fuel station on the corner of Timbavati and Kerk streets, open 24 hours a day for residents of Penina Park and motorists travelling through Polokwane. Forecourt attendants fill up cars with petrol or diesel and offer efficient, friendly service, so drivers can be on their way quickly.

The on-site Sasol Delight convenience store is secure and well stocked with snacks, hot drinks and everyday travel supplies, and because the station never closes, it is a useful stop for a late-night top-up or an early-morning coffee. Commuters heading to work and families setting off on a road trip can refuel and stock up in a single stop. For Penina Park and the surrounding suburbs, it is a dependable local garage at any hour. Sasol is on the corner of Timbavati and Kerk streets, Penina Park.

standard-bank-polokwane-polokwane-centra.description:
Standard Bank Polokwane is a full-service branch on Landdros Mare Street in the city centre, serving individuals, businesses and corporate clients. As one of the bank's main branches in Polokwane, it offers a complete range of personal and business banking under one roof.

Customers can apply for personal or business loans, meet consultants for investment advice and wealth management, and collect new or replacement bank cards. A large bank of ATMs at the branch accepts deposits and handles withdrawals around the clock, so customers can bank their cash even after the branch has closed. Clients are also helped to use Standard Bank's digital banking for routine transactions. Its central location makes it convenient for people working in town and for business owners who need to visit the bank during the day. Standard Bank is at 49 Landdros Mare Street, Polokwane Central.

dr-kgadi-mailula-dental-surgery-seshego.description:
This dental surgery in Seshego Circle Centre on Ditlou Street offers preventative, restorative and cosmetic dentistry to families and individuals in Seshego. It gives residents access to modern dental care close to home, without needing to travel into Polokwane for treatment.

Patients can book routine check-ups and deep cleans, have cavities filled or problem teeth extracted, and ask about cosmetic treatments to improve the look of their smile. The practice places a strong emphasis on personal, stress-free care, taking a gentle approach that helps anxious patients feel more relaxed in the chair. Modern equipment and a warm, welcoming setting help make each visit as comfortable as possible. For Seshego households looking for a dentist they can visit regularly, the surgery is conveniently located inside the shopping centre. It is at Shop 17C, Seshego Circle Centre, Seshego.

ladanna-post-office-ladanna.description:
Ladanna Post Office is a South African Post Office branch in the Tropicana Centre on Witklip Street, serving residents, small businesses and industrial firms in the Ladanna area. It gives the neighbourhood a local counter for sending and receiving post, so people don't have to travel into town for basic postal services.

At the counter, customers can post letters and parcels locally, send parcels internationally, use registered mail when they need proof of delivery, and buy stamps. The branch also handles a range of government and administrative transactions, which makes it a useful stop for paperwork as well as post. For businesses in the surrounding industrial area, it offers an affordable way to send documents and goods. Ladanna Post Office is at Shop 21, Tropicana Centre, Witklip Street, Ladanna.

russells-polokwane-market-street-polokwa.description:
Russells on Market Street is the Polokwane city-centre branch of the national furniture and homeware chain, helping families furnish their homes comfortably on a budget. The spacious showroom lets shoppers see and try out furniture before they buy, room by room.

The range includes lounge suites, beds and bedding, dining room sets and kitchen appliances, so a whole home can be furnished from one store. Prices are kept affordable, and customers can buy on credit to spread payments over time, which helps households get the furniture they need now rather than saving for months. Once a purchase is made, Russells can deliver it to the customer's door. Friendly service on the shop floor makes it easy to compare options and find something that suits both the space and the budget. Russells is at Shop 77, Market Street, Polokwane Central.

fnb-seshego-circle-seshego.description:
FNB Seshego Circle is a First National Bank branch in Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, at the corner of Nelson Mandela Drive and Polokwane Drive. It serves Seshego residents, shoppers and local business owners with everyday banking as well as investment products.

Consultants at the branch help clients open and run accounts, collect new or replacement cards and get comfortable with FNB's app and online banking, so routine payments and transfers can be done from home. Those wanting to grow their savings can also get advice on investment options. ATMs on site cover quick cash withdrawals and other transactions when a consultant isn't needed. Staff are friendly and efficient, and the branch's location inside the centre means banking can be done during a regular shopping trip. FNB is in Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, Seshego.

rixile-pharmacy-mankweng.description:
Rixile Pharmacy is a community pharmacy in the Cross Road Centre, at the corner of the R71 and University Road in Mankweng. It serves local families and students from the nearby University of Limpopo, offering prescription dispensing, basic health screenings and clinical advice from its pharmacists.

As well as prescription medicines, the pharmacy stocks over-the-counter treatments, vitamins, sports supplements and everyday personal care items, so customers can sort out their health needs and toiletries in one stop. Many people come here first when they feel unwell, getting advice on whether a pharmacy remedy will do or whether they should see a doctor. Customers value the warm welcome, the knowledgeable staff and the quick, efficient service, along with prices that suit student and family budgets. Rixile Pharmacy is at Shop 1, Cross Road Centre, Mankweng.

cw-towing-service-futura.description:
CW Towing Service is a vehicle recovery company on Corundum Street in Futura, Polokwane, that comes to the aid of motorists after breakdowns, accidents and mechanical failures. Its focus is on reaching stranded drivers quickly and getting their vehicles safely off the road.

The company runs flatbed tow trucks that can transport motorcycles, cars, light commercial vehicles and small fleet vehicles, with each one secured carefully for the journey. Where a vehicle has ended up off the road, the team can winch it out, and vehicles can be kept in secure storage until they are repaired or assessed. Long-distance towing is also available to destinations across Limpopo. For drivers who need help at short notice, CW Towing offers an affordable, dependable recovery service from a local operator. It is based at 55 Corundum Street, Futura, Polokwane.

fnb-lebowakgomo-lebowakgomo.description:
FNB Lebowakgomo occupies Shops 15 to 18 in Phasha Shopping Centre, at the corner of the R518 and R579, giving residents, shoppers and business owners a second First National Bank branch in town alongside the one at Mall@Lebo. The branch offers the full range of everyday personal banking.

Customers can come in to open or update accounts, pick up a new or replacement bank card, or sit down with a consultant to talk through their finances. Staff also show clients how to use FNB's digital banking, which cuts down on future trips to the branch. A row of ATMs at the branch handles withdrawals and other routine transactions quickly. With friendly, efficient service, it is a convenient option for anyone shopping at Phasha or living on that side of Lebowakgomo. FNB is at Shops 15–18, Phasha Shopping Centre.

harun-ebrahim-attorneys-nirvana.description:
Harun Ebrahim Attorneys is a law firm on Orient Drive in Nirvana that acts for individuals, families and businesses in Polokwane and across Limpopo. Its main areas of work are Road Accident Fund claims, civil litigation, the administration of deceased estates and divorce.

For people injured in a road accident, the firm helps lodge and pursue a claim against the Road Accident Fund, while its litigation work covers disputes that need to be argued in court. Families who have lost a loved one can rely on the firm to wind up the estate with care, and those going through a divorce receive sensitive, discreet guidance. Every client is given personal attention and complete confidentiality, backed by sound legal knowledge and an ethical approach. Harun Ebrahim Attorneys is at 287 Orient Drive, Nirvana, Polokwane.

isaiah-nyathi-attorneys-incorporated-fau.description:
Isaiah Nyathi Attorneys Incorporated is a law firm on Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park that specialises in debt recovery and commercial debt collection. Its clients include companies, financial institutions and local businesses across Limpopo that are owed money by customers or other businesses.

The firm's attorneys know South African consumer and credit law well, which allows them to pursue outstanding debts firmly while staying within the rules that protect debtors. Each matter is handled in a structured way, from the first letter of demand through to legal action where it becomes necessary. The aim is to recover what clients are owed as quickly as possible, reduce their exposure to bad debt and protect their cash flow, all through an ethical, client-focused approach. Isaiah Nyathi Attorneys Incorporated is at 103 Thabo Mbeki Street, Fauna Park, Polokwane.

mankweng-clinic-mankweng.description:
Mankweng Clinic is a public primary healthcare clinic in the Makweng Complex on University Street, Sovenga, serving families, residents and University of Limpopo students in the Mankweng area. For many in the community, it is the first place to turn when they need to see a health worker.

The clinic offers general medical consultations, ongoing care for people with chronic diseases, and routine immunisations for babies and children. Maternal healthcare supports women through pregnancy and after birth, and staff share health education aimed at preventing illness before it starts. Care is patient-centred and delivered with compassion by a dedicated team, helping make essential healthcare accessible to everyone in the area. For students far from their family doctor and residents managing long-term conditions, it provides dependable care close by. Mankweng Clinic is at Unit A, 614A University Street, Sovenga.

mcdonalds-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
McDonald's Savannah Mall is the global fast-food chain's restaurant at Savannah Mall in Fauna Park, on the corner of Thabo Mbeki and Grimm streets. It serves McDonald's familiar burgers and fries, along with a breakfast menu for shoppers and commuters starting their day.

The restaurant has a modern, welcoming dining area that suits families taking a break from shopping, as well as a quick counter service for anyone who wants to order and go. A McCafé counter serves speciality coffees and sweet treats, making it a handy spot for a mid-morning coffee or an afternoon snack. Service is fast and friendly, and the menu is consistent with what diners expect from McDonald's anywhere. For Savannah Mall shoppers and people passing through Fauna Park, it is an easy place to grab a meal. McDonald's is at Savannah Mall, Fauna Park, Polokwane.

benny-driver-training-ladanna.description:
Benny Driver Training is a driving school on Pietersburg Street in Ladanna, Polokwane, that helps new drivers become safe, confident and properly licensed. Its instruction follows the official K53 method used in South African driving tests, so learners practise exactly what examiners will be looking for.

Students start by preparing for the learner's licence test, learning the rules of the road, road signs and vehicle controls. Once they have their learner's licence, practical behind-the-wheel lessons build up their skills step by step, from basic vehicle handling to the manoeuvres and observation required on test day. Lessons can be booked online through the school's website or by email, which makes it easy to fit sessions around work or school. For anyone in Polokwane working towards a driver's licence, the school offers a clear, structured path. Benny Driver Training is at 77 Pietersburg Street, Ladanna.

goseame-wholesalers-ladine.description:
Goseame Wholesalers is a fresh produce market on Silicon Street in Polokwane Ext 17, Ladine, selling both wholesale and retail. Families come here to stock up for the month, while restaurants, caterers and other hospitality businesses buy in bulk to supply their kitchens.

The market stocks a wide range of fresh fruit and vegetables, along with quality meat from its on-site butchery, fresh flowers and everyday pantry staples. Buying in larger quantities at bulk prices helps households and businesses keep their food costs down, and the wide availability of stock means customers can usually get everything on their list. Service is efficient, so even big orders are handled without long waits. For anyone in Polokwane looking to buy fresh food for less, it is a practical place to shop. Goseame Wholesalers is at 23 Silicon Street, Polokwane Ext 17.

horak-de-bruin-oberholzer-inc-polokwane-.description:
Horak De Bruin Oberholzer Inc is a law firm on Joubert Street in Polokwane Central with a history going back to 1989. Over more than three decades, it has built its practice around property law, with a particular focus on conveyancing and notarial work.

The firm handles the legal side of buying and selling property, registering transfers and bonds so that ownership changes hands correctly, and drafting and registering notarial documents. Its clients include individual home buyers and sellers, estate agents and commercial property developers. Experienced attorneys guide each transaction from start to finish, aiming to make transfers run smoothly and ensuring agreements are legally sound. For anyone involved in a property deal in Polokwane, the firm offers long-standing local expertise. Horak De Bruin Oberholzer Inc is at 27 Joubert Street, Polokwane Central.

kalapeng-mall-lebo-pharmacy-lebowakgomo.description:
Kalapeng Mall@Lebo Pharmacy is a community pharmacy inside Mall@Lebo in Zone F, Lebowakgomo, and part of the Kalapeng Pharmacies group, which has been serving communities for more than 20 years. It gives Lebowakgomo families a dependable place to fill prescriptions and get health advice while they shop.

The full-service dispensary handles prescription medication, and the shelves carry a wide range of over-the-counter remedies as well as natural and herbal medicines for customers who prefer them. The pharmacy's clinic offers basic health screenings such as blood pressure and blood glucose checks, which help people keep an eye on conditions like hypertension and diabetes. For patients who can't easily get to the mall, local medication delivery is available. Pharmacists take time to give attentive, knowledgeable advice at the counter. Kalapeng Pharmacy is at Shop 25, Mall@Lebo, Lebowakgomo.

prime-spine-chiropractic-bendor.description:
Prime Spine is a chiropractic practice on General Maritz Street in Bendor Ext 10, Polokwane, offering non-invasive care for problems of the spine, muscles, joints and nerves. The practice aims to relieve pain and help patients recover and stay active over the long term.

Treatment covers sports injuries, recurring headaches, neck and back pain and nerve-related pain, and the practice also treats children using gentle techniques suited to younger patients. After an assessment, each patient receives a recovery plan tailored to their condition, age and lifestyle. The team combines modern chiropractic techniques with a caring, patient-centred approach, explaining each step of treatment along the way. From athletes and office workers to parents bringing in children, patients of all ages are seen. Prime Spine is at 101 General Maritz Street, Bendor Ext 10.

african-bank-seshego-circle-seshego.description:
African Bank Seshego Circle is an African Bank branch in Seshego Circle Shopping Centre on Ditlou Street, offering simple, affordable banking to Seshego residents and shoppers. The bank's approach is to keep its products straightforward and its fees clear, so customers know exactly what they are paying for.

At the branch, consultants help clients open and manage accounts, apply for personal loans and look at investment options for growing their savings. They also give practical financial advice for anyone planning a large purchase or trying to get on top of their budget. Clients can then use African Bank's digital banking for everyday transactions between visits. Friendly, efficient staff and a convenient spot inside the shopping centre make it easy to sort out banking while doing the weekly shop. African Bank is at Shop 13, Seshego Circle Shopping Centre, Seshego.

autozone-annadale.description:
AutoZone Annadale is a branch of the national AutoZone motor spares chain at the corner of Blaauwberg and Railway streets in Annadale, Polokwane. Alongside general auto parts and accessories, this outlet has a particular focus on diesel fuel injection parts and auto electrical spares, which makes it a useful supplier for diesel vehicle owners and auto electricians.

Motorists, home mechanics and workshops can also find batteries, brake parts, filters, engine components and tools on the shelves. Staff behind the counter know their parts and can help match the right component to a vehicle, and the store keeps a good range in stock so customers aren't left waiting for orders. With affordable prices on quality parts, it helps drivers keep their vehicles safe and roadworthy without overspending. AutoZone is on the corner of Blaauwberg and Railway streets, Annadale, Polokwane.

dorothy-langa-primary-school-seshego.description:
Dorothy Langa Primary School is a public primary school in Zone 2, Seshego, run by the Limpopo Department of Education in the Capricorn district. It is a no-fee school classified as Quintile 3, which means parents do not pay school fees, so children from local families, including those facing financial hardship, can get a sound basic education.

Learners follow the national CAPS curriculum, with a strong emphasis on reading, writing and numeracy in the early grades, as these foundations shape how children cope with every subject that follows. The school aims to provide a caring, structured environment where children can grow academically and personally. For Seshego families, it offers a local primary school where cost is not a barrier to education and children can learn close to home. Dorothy Langa Primary School is at Stand 3818, Zone 2, Seshego.

limpolo-new-used-spares-superbia.description:
Limpolo New & Used Spares is a registered Volkswagen spares specialist on Nikkel Street in the Superbia industrial area, trading since it was incorporated in 2015. It supplies both new and used VW parts, giving owners and mechanics the choice between new components and more affordable second-hand ones.

The stock covers engine components, body panels, electrical parts and gearbox and transmission parts, with used parts checked before they are sold. Local mechanics, workshops and VW owners come here to find the right part for repairs. The team's knowledge of Volkswagen models helps customers get the correct part first time. Competitive prices make it a practical option for keeping older VWs on the road. The business is open Monday to Saturday at 3 Nikkel Street, Superbia, Polokwane.

gilani-tile-warehouse-nirvana.description:
Gilani Tile Warehouse is a tile importer, wholesaler and retailer in Polokwane, operating as part of the Gilani Group since 2012. Its approach is to bring high-volume, low-margin pricing to home finishes, so homeowners and contractors can tile and finish a space for less.

The showroom displays a wide range of ceramic and porcelain floor and wall tiles alongside mosaics, PVC ceilings, decorative cornices, tile adhesives and sanitaryware, letting customers choose everything for a bathroom, kitchen or living area in one visit. Seasonal promotions and bulk pallet combo deals help keep costs down on larger projects, and the staff offer practical advice on choosing and quantifying materials. Whether renovating a single room or supplying a building site, buyers across Limpopo use the warehouse to source finishes at good prices.

serumula-optometrists-lebowakgomo.description:
Serumula Optometrists is an eye care practice in Phasha Shopping Centre, at the corner of the R518 and R579 in Lebowakgomo, looking after the vision of adults and children alike. Its optometrists test eyes thoroughly, diagnose problems with eyesight and recommend the right correction for each patient.

When glasses are needed, patients can choose from a range of stylish frames and have prescription lenses fitted, or opt for contact lenses instead. The practice also advises on how to manage different eye conditions and when further care might be needed. Its friendly, patient-centred team explains results clearly, so patients understand their eyes and their options. Being inside the shopping centre makes it simple to book an eye test during a shopping trip, giving Lebowakgomo residents professional eye care without travelling to Polokwane. Serumula Optometrists is at Shop 23, Phasha Shopping Centre.

tops-game-centre-polokwane-central.description:
TOPS at SPAR Game Centre is the SPAR Group's liquor store in Game Centre, at the corner of Hospital and Market streets in the Polokwane CBD. It sits alongside the SPAR grocery store in the centre, so shoppers can pick up drinks while doing their regular grocery shopping in town.

The store carries a broad selection of beers, ciders, wines, spirits and liqueurs, catering for everyday buys as well as celebrations. Prices are competitive and regular promotions add extra value. For customers who would rather not carry their order home, TOPS at SPAR offers a home delivery service, which is handy for larger orders or bulk purchases for an event. Shoppers describe it as a secure, easy place to buy drinks in the city centre. TOPS at SPAR is at Shop 0010, Game Centre, Polokwane Central.

baby-city-savannah-mall-fauna-park.description:
Baby City at Savannah Mall is a branch of the South African baby store chain, now part of the Dis-Chem group, catering for parents, parents-to-be and caregivers in Fauna Park and beyond. The store specialises in everything needed for babies and toddlers, from the big purchases made before birth to the everyday essentials that follow.

Shoppers can compare prams, cots, car seats and nursery furniture from well-known brands, along with baby and toddler clothing and a range of feeding and wellness products. Knowledgeable consultants on the shop floor help parents choose the right car seat or pram for their needs and explain how products work, which is especially useful for first-time parents. The store has a welcoming, relaxed atmosphere for browsing with little ones in tow. Baby City is at Shop 75, Savannah Mall, on the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki streets.

badenhorst-attorney-bendor.description:
Badenhorst Attorney is a boutique legal practice on the first floor of 6a Pierre Street in Bendor, Polokwane, acting for individuals, families and local businesses. Its work centres on three areas: conveyancing, civil litigation and notarial services.

On the property side, the practice handles the transfer of homes and other property between buyers and sellers, making sure each registration is done correctly. Its litigation work covers civil disputes that need to be resolved through the courts, while its notarial services cover documents that must be prepared and attested by a notary. As a smaller firm, it gives each client personal attention and handles every matter in strict confidence, combining a sound knowledge of property and general law with an ethical approach. Badenhorst Attorney is on the first floor, 6a Pierre Street, Bendor.

brave-group-security-services-ladanna.description:
Brave Group Security Services is a private security company based on Diamant Street in Ladanna, protecting homes and businesses across the greater Polokwane area. It offers a range of security services that can be combined to suit each property, from a single household to a commercial site.

Clients can have trained security guards posted at their premises, CCTV cameras installed to monitor their property, and access control systems fitted to manage who comes and goes. When an alarm is triggered, the company coordinates armed response so help reaches the scene quickly. By pairing local knowledge of the area with modern monitoring technology, the team aims to spot and reduce risks before they become incidents, giving families and business owners protection around the clock. Brave Group Security Services is at 2 Diamant Street, Ladanna, Polokwane.

brilliant-bass-boats-superbia.description:
Brilliant Bass Boats & Fishing Tackle is a retail and wholesale supplier of boats, fishing tackle and boating equipment on Rupee Avenue in the Superbia industrial area. It caters for keen anglers and experienced boaters alike, with stock that covers everything from the boat itself to the gear used on the water.

The range includes specialised bass boats, rod and reel combinations, fishing tackle and marine accessories, so customers can kit out a new boat or upgrade their fishing setup in one place. The team shares practical, knowledgeable advice on choosing the right equipment for different types of fishing and water, which is especially helpful for anyone buying their first boat. For anglers across Limpopo heading to the region's dams and rivers, the shop is a well-stocked local source of boating and fishing gear. Brilliant Bass Boats is at 9 Rupee Avenue, Superbia, Polokwane.

shoprite-lebowakgomo-lebowakgomo.description:
Shoprite Lebowakgomo is the anchor supermarket in Phasha Shopping Centre, at the busy corner of the R518 and R579, and part of the national Shoprite chain. It is focused on helping local households make their money go further, with low everyday prices across a wide range of products.

Shoppers can buy groceries, fresh fruit and vegetables, meat and household essentials under one roof, whether they are doing a big monthly stock-up for the family or just popping in for bread and milk. Consistent value and friendly service at the tills make it a dependable choice for residents across the greater Lebowakgomo area. Its location at a main intersection also makes it convenient for people travelling to and from work or nearby villages. Shoprite is at Site 4, Phasha Shopping Centre, Lebowakgomo.

speed-services-couriers-superbia.description:
Speed Services Couriers is the express courier division of the South African Post Office, operating its Polokwane branch from Kobalt Street in the Superbia industrial area. It connects local businesses and residents to a national overnight courier network for time-sensitive deliveries across South Africa.

Customers can send documents and parcels counter to counter, or arrange door-to-door delivery for larger consignments and freight. Standard overnight delivery covers most needs, while early-morning delivery options are available when items must arrive at the start of the next business day. Online sellers use the service to get orders to their customers, and companies rely on it to move documents and stock between branches and suppliers. With affordable rates and a nationwide reach, it offers a secure, professional way to send items within the country. Speed Services is at 9 Kobalt Street, Superbia, Polokwane.

cream-car-wash-polokwane-fauna-park.description:
CREAM Car Wash Polokwane is a car wash and detailing outlet on Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park, offering everything from a quick wash to a full valet. Drivers can pull in for a standard high-pressure exterior wash and interior vacuum, or book a more thorough clean when the car needs extra attention.

For deeper cleaning, the team shampoos upholstery, works through the interior in detail and polishes paintwork to bring back the shine. Quality cleaning products and modern equipment help get good results while protecting the vehicle's finish, which also helps maintain its value over time. Quick turnaround times mean customers aren't left waiting long, making it easy to fit a wash into a busy day. For residents of Fauna Park and nearby suburbs, it is a convenient place to keep a vehicle looking its best. CREAM Car Wash is on Thabo Mbeki Street, Fauna Park, Polokwane.

fauna-veterinary-clinic-fauna-park.description:
Fauna Veterinary Clinic is a veterinary practice on Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park that looks after the health of companion animals, treating pets as the valued family members they are. Owners can bring their animals in for routine check-ups, consultations when something seems wrong, and diagnostic work to get to the bottom of a problem.

The clinic's services include vaccinations to protect pets against common diseases, surgical procedures, dental care and advice on diet and nutrition. Preventative medicine is a key part of its approach, helping pets stay healthy and catching problems early. The veterinary team combines clinical skill with compassion, taking time to explain conditions and treatment options to worried owners. For pet owners in Fauna Park and across Polokwane, it offers attentive, all-round care close to home. Fauna Veterinary Clinic is at 49A Thabo Mbeki Street, Fauna Park.

head-recon-service-superbia.description:
