Head Recon Service is a motor engineering workshop on Mangaan Street in the Superbia industrial area that specialises, as its name suggests, in reconditioning cylinder heads. It also takes on related engine repair work, restoring key engine components so they perform as they should.

The workshop pressure tests cylinder heads to find cracks and leaks, skims them flat, refaces valves and carries out complete head rebuilds using specialised engineering machinery. Its customers include private vehicle owners, fleet operators and other mechanics who send out head work they are not equipped to do themselves. Careful, precise workmanship helps restore engine performance, prevents more expensive failures further down the line and extends the working life of the vehicle. For anyone dealing with overheating, a blown head gasket or a tired engine, it is a specialist worth knowing. Head Recon Service is at 16 Mangaan Street, Superbia, Polokwane.

lighthouse-mica-hardware-polokwane-centr.description:
Lighthouse Mica Hardware is a long-established hardware store on Jorissen Street in Polokwane Central, trading under the national Mica brand. It supplies DIY essentials, building materials and tools to homeowners tackling their own projects as well as to builders and contractors.

The shelves carry well-known paint brands, timber, floor tiles and sanitaryware, together with the everyday hardware needed for repairs around the house. Whether a customer needs a tin of paint and a few screws or materials for a full bathroom renovation, the store can usually help. Staff are known for their practical advice and friendly service, helping customers work out what they need and how to use it. Its central location makes it easy to reach for anyone working or living in town. Lighthouse Mica Hardware is at 16 Jorissen Street, Polokwane Central.

nirvana-supermarket-nirvana.description:
Nirvana Supermarket is a neighbourhood grocery store on Crescent Drive in Nirvana, giving local families a convenient place to shop without leaving the suburb. Alongside everyday groceries, it runs its own in-store departments that set it apart from a basic corner shop.

A full-service butchery offers a range of quality meat cuts, while the bakery and deli section turns out fresh baked goods every day along with ready-to-eat meals for busy evenings. The shelves also carry fresh produce, pantry staples and household necessities, so families can do their weekly shop in one place. The store focuses on good value, a wide variety of products and friendly service, which keeps residents coming back. For Nirvana households, it means fresh meat, bread and groceries close to home. Nirvana Supermarket is at 126 Crescent Drive, Nirvana, Polokwane.

nkateko-pharmacy-seshego.description:
Nkateko Pharmacy is a community pharmacy in Seshego Plaza on New Era Drive, helping Seshego residents look after their health close to home. Its pharmacists dispense prescription medicines and help customers choose from a wide range of over-the-counter medications and vitamins.

Beyond filling scripts, the team offers personal health advice, routine health screenings and wellness consultations, giving customers practical guidance on managing everyday health concerns. The shop also stocks wellness products and daily personal care items, making it possible to take care of several needs in one visit. Customers value the patient-focused approach and affordable prices, and the pharmacy's spot in the plaza makes it easy to call in while shopping. Nkateko Pharmacy is at Shop 8, Seshego Plaza, New Era Drive, Seshego.

polokwane-north-dental-clinic-ivy-park.description:
Polokwane North Dental Clinic is a family dental practice in the Food Zone Complex on Campbell Street, Ivy Park. It offers general and preventive dentistry for patients of all ages, with the aim of keeping teeth healthy and helping patients feel confident about their smiles.

Patients can book regular check-ups and deep cleans to stop problems before they start, have cavities filled or damaged teeth extracted, and ask about cosmetic treatments to improve the appearance of their teeth. The team uses modern dental equipment and takes a gentle, patient-centred approach, working to keep each visit as comfortable as possible. For families in Ivy Park and the northern suburbs, it is a convenient practice for routine care and treatment alike, with the whole household able to see the same dentist. Polokwane North Dental Clinic is at Shop 2, Food Zone Complex, 34 Campbell Street, Ivy Park.

rocomamas-thornhill-thornhill-estate.description:
RocoMamas Thornhill is a branch of the national casual dining chain in Thornhill Shopping Centre on Munnik Avenue, known for its rock 'n' roll atmosphere and open-style kitchen. The menu is built around smashburgers that diners can customise with their choice of toppings, along with sticky ribs and spicy chicken wings.

Generous portions and bold flavours are the main draw, and the drinks menu includes creative milkshakes that suit both children and adults. The lively, upbeat setting makes it a popular choice for families, groups of friends and anyone looking for a relaxed meal out. Diners can sit down and eat in the restaurant or order takeaways to enjoy at home, with friendly service either way. For Thornhill residents and shoppers at the centre, it is an easy spot for a fun, filling meal. RocoMamas is at Shop 39, Thornhill Shopping Centre, Thornhill.

supa-quick-tyre-experts-paledi-mankweng.description:
Supa Quick Tyre Experts Paledi is a tyre and fitment centre at Paledi Mall on the R71 in Mankweng, part of the national Supa Quick network. It supplies and fits brand-name tyres, along with batteries, brakes, shock absorbers and exhaust systems, covering the parts that matter most for a vehicle's safety on the road.

Trained technicians carry out wheel alignment and balancing to help tyres wear evenly and keep the car tracking straight, and they run safety checks so problems can be spotted before they become dangerous. Service is quick and professional, helping drivers get back on the road without a long wait. Local commuters and motorists who regularly drive long distances across Limpopo rely on the centre to keep their vehicles safe and roadworthy. Supa Quick is at Paledi Mall, R71, Mankweng.

jet-mankweng.description:
Jet at Paledi Mall is a discount fashion store in Mankweng, offering affordable clothing, shoes and accessories for the whole family. From babies and young children to teens and adults, shoppers can find stylish everyday outfits and seasonal ranges at prices that suit tight household budgets.

Beyond clothing, the store stocks homeware essentials, cellular products and beauty items, so customers can pick up several things for the household in one visit. The range is regularly updated with current trends, letting families stay fashionable without spending a lot. With its focus on value and convenience, it is a regular stop for Mankweng residents doing their shopping at the mall. Jet is at Shops 9 to 11, Paledi Mall, Main Road, Mankweng.

s-h-s-security-fauna-park.description:
S H S Security is a private security company on Gazelle Street in Fauna Park, providing round-the-clock protection for homes and businesses in Polokwane. Its services can be tailored to each property, whether a family home needs extra peace of mind or a business needs guards on site.

The company deploys security guards at clients' premises, runs regular patrols to deter criminals, installs monitoring equipment and coordinates a fast response when an incident occurs. Its team draws on local knowledge of the area and keeps a close watch on each property to reduce the risk of break-ins and loss. Because protection runs 24 hours a day, clients can call on the company for help at any hour, including during emergencies at night. S H S Security is at 50 Gazelle Street, Fauna Park, Polokwane.

tile-africa-polokwane-north-thornhill-es.description:
Tile Africa Polokwane North is a branch of the national tile and bathroomware chain, trading from a spacious showroom in Baobab Gardens on Munnik Avenue. It caters for homeowners, interior designers and building contractors working on both homes and commercial properties.

The showroom displays a wide variety of ceramic, porcelain and natural stone tiles for floors and walls, together with other flooring options. Its bathroomware range includes contemporary taps, basins, toilets and showers, so customers can plan an entire bathroom or kitchen from one store. Room-style displays help shoppers picture how different finishes work together, and knowledgeable consultants are on hand to advise on choosing the right products for each space. Whether updating a single room or fitting out a new build, clients can find what they need here. Tile Africa is in Baobab Gardens, Munnik Avenue, Polokwane.
